strings.translation: 你的炉石法环已经开启了。

strings.english: The ring fills in {1} seconds. Be inside it when it does to return to the Inn with your loot!
strings.translation: 法环将在{1}秒后填满。填满时站在其中，即可带着战利品返回旅店！

strings.translation: 你的嗜血雕文觉醒了。{2}秒内，你的攻击和持续伤害的触发频率提高{1}%。

strings.english: Something answers the summons. It arrives in {1}.
strings.translation: 有什么东西响应了召唤。它将在{1}后到来。
祭坛的守卫将在{1}后到来。

strings.translation: 它已不再适合你的构筑。

{1} doesn't restock. Sayge's Restock upgrade lets him restock during a visit.
strings.translation: {1}不会补货。塞格的补货升级能让他在造访期间补货。

strings.english: An elite training dummy stands ready.
strings.translation: 一个精英训练木桩已就绪。

strings.english: A boss training dummy stands ready.
strings.translation: 一个首领训练木桩已就绪。

strings.english: The sandbox is full. Clear some enemies first.
strings.translation: 沙盒已满。请先清除一些敌人。

strings.english: God mode is on: damage stops at 1 health.
strings.translation: 无敌模式已开启：伤害不会让你的生命值低于1点。

strings.english: New dummies have 100 times the health and refill below half, so every hit counts on the meter.
strings.translation: 新木桩的生命值为原来的100倍，并会在低于一半时回满，因此每次攻击都会计入伤害统计。

strings.english: Each enemy melee swing now reports its distance and reach in chat.
strings.translation: 现在敌人的每次近战挥击都会在聊天框中报告挥击距离和攻击范围。

strings.english: Melee swing distances are no longer reported.
strings.translation: 不再报告近战挥击距离。

strings.english: Enemy moves are off: enemies only walk and swing.
strings.translation: 敌人招式已关闭：敌人只会走动和近战攻击。

strings.english: Enemies are passive now: they don't move, attack or cast.
strings.translation: 敌人现在处于被动状态：不会移动、攻击或施法。
敌人的生命值现在不会低于1点。
经验水晶环绕在你周围。

strings.english: New enemies are as tough as at minute {1} of a run.
strings.translation: 新敌人的强度相当于远征第{1}分钟时的水平。

strings.english: Enemy toughness follows your time in the sandbox again.
strings.translation: 敌人强度重新根据你在沙盒中的时间计算。

strings.english: You can't start a run while dead.
strings.translation: 你不能在死亡状态下开始远征。

strings.translation: {1}难度中没有名为“{2}”的区域或地下城。

The spellbook needs the Hordes of Azeroth addon.
strings.translation: 法术书需要 Hordes of Azeroth 插件。

strings.english: Leave the run first with .bonk stop.
strings.translation: 请先使用 .bonk stop 离开远征。

strings.english: You can't go back to the Inn right now.
Use .bonk gear equip, .bonk gear equip <slot>, .bonk gear loot or .bonk gear salvage.
strings.translation: 请使用 .bonk gear equip、.bonk gear equip <slot>、.bonk gear loot 或 .bonk gear salvage。

strings.english: You can't change what runs offer during a run.
strings.translation: 你不能在远征中更改远征会提供的内容。
用法：.bonk vendor buy|lock <number>，.bonk vendor reroll|close

strings.english: The merchant is on his way.
Only Darkmoon Cards and Glyphs can be banned.
strings.translation: 只能禁用暗月卡片和雕文。

strings.english: You can only ban Darkmoon Cards and Glyphs you have unlocked.
strings.translation: 你只能禁用已解锁的暗月卡片和雕文。

strings.english: All your Darkmoon Card ban slots are in use. Allow a banned one first, or earn another slot.
strings.translation: 你的暗月卡片禁用栏位已全部用完。请先重新允许一张已禁用的卡片，或再获得一个栏位。

strings.english: All your Glyph ban slots are in use. Allow a banned one first, or earn another slot.
strings.translation: 你的雕文禁用栏位已全部用完。请先重新允许一个已禁用的雕文，或再获得一个栏位。

strings.english: You have no Darkmoon Card ban slots yet.
strings.translation: 你还没有暗月卡片禁用栏位。

strings.english: You have no Glyph ban slots yet.
strings.translation: 你还没有雕文禁用栏位。

strings.english: That one is not a boss or mini-boss, so its moves are not reported.
strings.translation: 该敌人不是首领或小首领，因此不会报告它的招式。

strings.english: Clear Heroic to unlock ranks {1} to {2}.
strings.translation: 通关英雄难度即可解锁{1}到{2}级。

strings.english: Clear Mythic floor {1} to unlock rank {2}.
strings.translation: 通关史诗第{1}层即可解锁{2}级。

strings.english: Learn {1} in the {2} talents to unlock it.
strings.translation: 学习{2}天赋中的{1}即可解锁。

strings.english: The enchanter only works during a run.
strings.translation: 附魔师只在远征中提供服务。

strings.english: You can inspect your talents during a run.
strings.translation: 你可以在远征中查看你的天赋。

strings.english: Preset {1} is now active. Spend your talent points to build it.
strings.translation: 已启用预设{1}。投入你的天赋点来配置它。

strings.english: Preset {1} is now active. {2} talent point could not be placed.
strings.translation: 已启用预设{1}。有{2}个天赋点无法分配。

strings.english: Preset {1} is now active. {2} talent points could not be placed.
strings.translation: 已启用预设{1}。有{2}个天赋点无法分配。

strings.english: Talk to the Mythic Quartermaster to reroll gear.
strings.translation: 与史诗军需官交谈来重选装备属性。

strings.english: Only bonus stats on gear you found in Mythic runs can be rerolled.
strings.translation: 只有在史诗远征中找到的装备的额外属性才能重选。

strings.english: You may only reroll one stat per item.
strings.translation: 每件物品只能重选一项属性。

strings.english: Reroll the stat again to get new choices.
strings.translation: 再次重选该属性以获得新的选项。

strings.english: Talk to the Mythic Quartermaster to upgrade gear.
strings.translation: 与史诗军需官交谈来升级装备。

strings.english: Only gear you found in Mythic runs can be upgraded.
strings.translation: 只有在史诗远征中找到的装备才能升级。

strings.english: Clear Mythic floor {1} to raise this to {2}.
strings.translation: 通关史诗第{1}层后才能将其提升至{2}。
你需要{1}废料。你目前拥有{2}点。

strings.english: You have no room to upgrade {1}.
You can't start on floor {1} yet. Checkpoints open {2} floors below your best Mythic floor for this class.
strings.translation: 你还不能从第{1}层开始。检查点在你该职业的最高史诗楼层往下{2}层处开放。

strings.english: Trinkets have new effects, so yours were moved to your bags. Hover them to see what they do now.
strings.translation: 饰品有了新的效果，因此你的饰品已被移入背包。将鼠标悬停在上面即可查看它们现在的效果。

strings.english: There are no catch-up level-ups left.
strings.translation: 没有剩余的追赶升级了。

strings.english: This selection only shows new cards. Pick one yourself.
strings.translation: 这次的选项只有新卡片。请自己选择一个。

strings.english: You start on floor {1} at level {2}. Pick your build, then the floor begins. Skipped floors give only their glyph choices.
strings.translation: 你从第{1}层开始，等级为{2}。先选好你的配置，然后该层开始。跳过的楼层只提供它们的雕文选择。

strings.english: Talk to the enchanter at the end of a floor to enchant your gear.
strings.translation: 在每层结束时与附魔师交谈来附魔你的装备。

strings.english: Pick an enchant or keep the one you have first.
strings.translation: 请先选择一个附魔，或保留你现有的附魔。

strings.english: An enchant costs {1} Valor. You have {2}.
strings.translation: 一次附魔需要{1}勇气点数。你目前拥有{2}点。

strings.english: There is no enchant to pick.
{1} has {2} of {3} health, kept as {4} at 1/{5}.
{1}% of a normal enemy's health on Normal
strings.translation: 普通难度下普通敌人生命值的{1}%

strings.english: +1% damage per point, for you and your summons. Power on gear gives +0.5% per point and multiplies with your other Power.
strings.translation: 每点使你和你的召唤物造成的伤害提高1%。装备上的力量每点提供0.5%，并与你的其他力量相乘。
每点使最大生命值提高1%。

strings.english: {1}% base. Spells crit for 150% damage, attacks for 200%. Above 100%, a hit can crit twice.
strings.translation: 基础为{1}%。法术的致命一击造成150%伤害，攻击造成200%伤害。几率超过100%时，一次命中可以造成两次致命一击。
每点使致命一击伤害提高1%。

strings.english: shorter cooldowns and faster damage over time. Diminishing returns, up to {1}%. Gear gives at most {2}%. Short Haste boosts go past the cap.
strings.translation: 缩短冷却时间，并使持续伤害跳得更快。收益递减，最多{1}%。装备最多提供{2}%。短暂的急速提升可以超过上限。

strings.english: bigger AoE spells. Diminishing returns, up to {1}%. Doesn't affect other spells or summons.
strings.translation: 扩大范围法术的作用范围。收益递减，最多{1}%。不影响其他法术或召唤物。

strings.english: +1 bolt, shot, swing, pet or totem per point, up to {1}. Other AoE spells ignore it.
strings.translation: 每点使飞弹、射击、挥击、宠物或图腾的数量+1，最多+{1}。其他范围法术不受其影响。

strings.english: chance to dodge enemy melee attacks, up to {1}%. Evasion and Deterrence go past the cap.
strings.translation: 闪避敌人近战攻击的几率，最多{1}%。“闪避”和“威慑”技能可以超过上限。

strings.english: 20 Armor reduces damage taken by 16%, 100 Armor by 43%, and 300 Armor by 60%, the most it can. Each point above 300 gives +0.5% maximum health.
strings.translation: 20点护甲使受到的伤害降低16%，100点护甲降低43%，300点护甲降低60%，此为上限。超过300的每点护甲提供+0.5%最大生命值。

strings.english: absorbs damage up to a share of maximum health. Refills after {1} without taking damage. All shields together hold at most 50% of maximum health, 100% with Juggernaut.
strings.translation: 吸收最多相当于最大生命值一定比例的伤害。{1}内未受到伤害后重新充满。所有护盾合计最多吸收相当于最大生命值50%的伤害，拥有重装碾压时为100%。

strings.english: your hits have a 1% chance per point to heal 1% of maximum health, up to 0.03% of maximum health per second per point. Summon hits don't count.
strings.translation: 每点使你的命中有1%几率恢复1%最大生命值，每点每秒最多恢复0.03%最大生命值。召唤物的命中不计入。

strings.english: heals 1% of maximum health per second per point. Healing cuts reduce it.
strings.translation: 每点每秒恢复1%最大生命值。治疗削减效果会使其降低。

strings.english: rarer level-up, card, glyph and Ley Line choices. +0.1% elite chest chance and +0.1% evolution chance per point.
strings.translation: 提高升级、卡片、雕文和魔网选项的稀有度。每点使精英掉落宝箱的几率+0.1%，进化几率+0.1%。

strings.english: 6 yards base, +1% per point, up to 30 yards. Darkmoon Tickets and glyphs always need 3 yards.
strings.translation: 基础6码，每点+1%，最多30码。暗月奖券和雕文始终需要在3码内才能拾取。

strings.english: +1% per point, up to {1}%. Short speed boosts go past it.
strings.translation: 每点+1%，最多{1}%。短暂的加速效果可以超过此上限。

strings.english: more gold. Doesn't affect Valor or Darkmoon Tickets.
strings.translation: 获得更多金币。不影响勇气点数和暗月奖券。

strings.english: each run that ends in death before your first Normal clear gives +{1} Power and {1}% less damage taken, up to {2} stacks.
strings.translation: 在你首次通关普通难度之前，每次以死亡告终的远征都会使你获得+{1}力量，并使受到的伤害降低{1}%，最多叠加{2}层。

strings.english: Stats from gear, cards, glyphs, passives, talents, Training and Ley Lines add together. Caps apply to the total.
strings.translation: 来自装备、卡片、雕文、被动技能、天赋、训练和魔网的属性会相加。上限作用于总值。

strings.english: Critical strike chance has no cap.
strings.translation: 致命一击几率没有上限。

strings.english: Talent damage bonuses add to Power. Spell ranks, Hunter's Mark, Judged, keyword payoffs and capstones multiply with it.
strings.translation: 天赋的伤害加成计入力量。法术等级、猎人印记、被审判、关键词收益和终极天赋与其相乘。

strings.english: Vulnerabilities and Sunder Armor multiply with everything else.
strings.translation: 易伤和破甲与其他所有加成相乘。

strings.english: Each passive rank and each extra card copy is worth 85% of the one before, never below 10%. Count doesn't shrink, and Rested has no floor.
strings.translation: 被动技能的每一级和每多一张相同的卡片，效果为前一个的85%，但不低于10%。数量不会递减，休憩也没有下限。

strings.english: Two trinkets with the same effect don't stack it.
strings.translation: 两件特效相同的饰品，其特效不会叠加。

strings.english: shortened by Haste, including the spell's own Haste upgrades. Never below 0.2 sec. A spell with no target in range waits instead of starting its cooldown.
strings.translation: 受急速缩短，其中包括法术自身的急速强化。最低0.2秒。范围内没有目标的法术会等待，而不是进入冷却。

strings.english: Common +{1}% damage, Uncommon +{2}%, Rare +{3}% and 1 upgrade, Epic +{4}% and 2 upgrades. Spells without damage get upgrades instead. Past rank 20 the damage per rank shrinks: rank 40 adds half, rank 80 a quarter.
strings.translation: 普通+{1}%伤害，优秀+{2}%，精良+{3}%并获得1项强化，史诗+{4}%并获得2项强化。没有伤害的法术改为获得强化。超过20级后，每级增加的伤害逐渐减少：到40级时为一半，到80级时为四分之一。

strings.english: Hit Twice, Echo and Targets come only from Epic ranks.
strings.translation: 双重打击、回响和目标数强化只会来自史诗等级。

strings.english: Evolutions can appear from rank 10, earlier with Premonition, and keep your rank, damage and upgrades.
strings.translation: 进化从10级起可能出现，拥有预感时会更早出现，并保留你的等级、伤害和强化。

strings.english: Spell hits vary by 7% either way, pet attacks by 10%. Damage over time doesn't vary.
strings.translation: 法术命中的伤害会上下浮动7%，宠物攻击浮动10%。持续伤害不会浮动。

strings.english: You start with 3 spell slots and 3 passive slots. Sayge sells more, up to 5 spells and 6 passives.
strings.translation: 你初始拥有3个法术槽位和3个被动技能槽位。塞格出售更多槽位，最多5个法术和6个被动技能。

strings.english: the health of a normal enemy of the zone's level on Normal. It doesn't grow with difficulty, floors, elites or bosses.
strings.translation: 普通难度下与该区域等级相同的普通敌人的生命值。它不会随难度、楼层、精英或首领而提高。

strings.english: Burning, Bleed, Poison, Decay and Moonfire: each stack deals {1}% of base health every tick for {2}, up to {3} stacks.
strings.translation: 燃烧、流血、中毒、腐朽和月火术：每层每跳造成基础生命值{1}%的伤害，持续{2}，最多{3}层。

strings.english: each stack deals {1}% of base health every tick for {2}, growing to 3 times as strong over 8 ticks. It doesn't spread on death.
strings.translation: 每层每跳造成基础生命值{1}%的伤害，持续{2}，并在8跳内逐渐增强至3倍。目标死亡时不会蔓延。

strings.english: A tick is 1 sec, faster with Haste.
strings.translation: 每跳间隔1秒，急速可缩短该间隔。

strings.english: Damage over time can critically strike only with a talent, for half the usual critical strike bonus.
strings.translation: 只有拥有相应天赋时，持续伤害才能造成致命一击，且致命一击的伤害加成只有通常的一半。

strings.english: Each new stack refreshes all stacks on that enemy.
strings.translation: 每叠加新的一层，都会刷新该敌人身上的所有层数。

strings.english: Power counts when stacks are added or expire. Vulnerabilities count on every tick.
strings.translation: 力量在叠加层数或层数结束时计入。易伤则在每跳时计入。

strings.english: When an enemy with 2 or more stacks dies, half its stacks spread to the 2 nearest enemies within 8 yards.
strings.translation: 拥有2层或以上效果的敌人死亡时，其一半的层数会蔓延至8码内最近的2个敌人。

strings.english: Bosses take the same damage per stack; it's a smaller share of their health.
strings.translation: 首领每层受到的伤害相同，只是占其生命值的比例更小。

strings.english: Ticks can trigger Leech. They don't trigger cards or trinkets.
strings.translation: 每跳伤害可以触发吸血，但不会触发卡片或饰品。

strings.english: {1}% slow per stack, up to {2}. At {2} stacks the enemy is Frozen.
strings.translation: 每层减速{1}%，最多{2}层。达到{2}层时，敌人会被冻结。

strings.english: normal enemies are rooted for {1}; elites and bosses keep moving but count as Frozen. Your Frost spells always crit Frozen enemies, and your critical strikes on them deal +50% critical strike damage.
strings.translation: 普通敌人被定身{1}；精英和首领仍可移动，但视为冻结。你的冰霜法术对冻结的敌人必定造成致命一击，且你对其造成的致命一击获得+50%致命一击伤害。

strings.english: at {1} stacks, lightning strikes the enemy and up to 3 enemies within 6 yards for {2}% of base health, raised by Power. It can crit.
strings.translation: 达到{1}层时，闪电会打击该敌人及其6码内最多3个敌人，造成基础生命值{2}%的伤害，受力量加成。可以造成致命一击。

strings.english: marked enemies take {1}% more damage from you and your summons, raised by the marking spell's ranks and Mark upgrades up to 30%. Talents add on top. On death it passes to the 2 nearest unmarked enemies within 10 yards.
strings.translation: 被标记的敌人受到你和你的召唤物造成的伤害提高{1}%，施加标记的法术的等级和标记强化可将其最多提高至30%。天赋效果额外叠加。目标死亡时，标记会转移到10码内最近的2个未被标记的敌人身上。

strings.english: enemies hit by Judgement of the Crusader take 20% more damage from you for 6 sec.
strings.translation: 被十字军审判击中的敌人受到你造成的伤害提高20%，持续6秒。

strings.english: {1}% slow for {2}. Only the strongest slow counts.
strings.translation: 减速{1}%，持续{2}。只有效果最强的减速生效。

strings.english: Fire +{1}%, Shadow +{2}%, Nature +{3}% and Sunder Armor (Physical) +{4}% damage taken per stack, up to 5 stacks.
strings.translation: 火焰易伤每层使受到的伤害提高{1}%，暗影易伤{2}%，自然易伤{3}%，破甲（物理）{4}%，最多5层。

strings.english: Stuns last at most 2 sec, then the enemy can't be stunned for 6 sec. Bosses and mini-bosses can't be stunned.
strings.translation: 昏迷最多持续2秒，之后该敌人在6秒内无法再被昏迷。首领和小首领无法被昏迷。

strings.english: Roots work on normal enemies only and last at most 2 sec, then 6 sec immune. Frozen shares this timer.
strings.translation: 定身只对普通敌人有效，最多持续2秒，之后免疫6秒。冻结与其共用此计时。

strings.english: Knockbacks work on normal enemies only, then 6 sec immune. Pulls work on normal enemies only, then 3 sec immune.
strings.translation: 击退只对普通敌人有效，之后免疫6秒。牵引只对普通敌人有效，之后免疫3秒。

strings.english: Fear and charm don't work on elites or bosses.
strings.translation: 恐惧和魅惑对精英和首领无效。

strings.english: Summons get your Power, critical strike chance and damage, Haste and Movement Speed. They never die and enemies ignore them.
strings.translation: 召唤物继承你的力量、致命一击几率和致命一击伤害、急速以及移动速度。它们永远不会死亡，敌人也会无视它们。

strings.english: Summons don't get your Area. Their hits don't trigger Leech, trinkets or on-hit cards, but their kills count.
strings.translation: 召唤物不继承你的范围。它们的命中不会触发吸血、饰品或命中触发的卡片，但它们的击杀会计入。

strings.english: Every summon hit applies its spell's keyword.
strings.translation: 召唤物的每次命中都会施加其所属法术的关键词。

strings.english: Count adds pets, elementals, treants, totems and wolves.
strings.translation: 数量可增加宠物、元素、树人、图腾和狼。

strings.english: Summons that leave on their own, like snakes, beasts, Stampede, Spirit Pack wolves and warlock demons, last longer with Duration.
strings.translation: 会自行消失的召唤物（如毒蛇、野兽、兽群奔腾、灵魂之群的狼和术士的恶魔）受持续时间加成，存在时间更长。

strings.english: 5% chance when a spell is cast, at most once per cooldown. Damage trinkets deal a share of that spell's next hit, more with Count, and can crit. Area doesn't affect them.
strings.translation: 施放法术时有5%几率触发，每个冷却周期最多一次。伤害类饰品按该法术下一次命中伤害的一定比例造成伤害，数量越多伤害越高，并且可以造成致命一击。范围不影响它们。

strings.english: Fire Burst, Shadow Burst, Chain Lightning and Death Ray roll when a spell is cast and fire on that spell's next hit.
strings.translation: 火焰爆发、暗影爆发、闪电链和死亡射线在施放法术时判定，并在该法术的下一次命中时触发。

strings.english: Procs never trigger other trinkets or cards. Their hits can trigger Leech.
strings.translation: 触发效果永远不会触发其他饰品或卡片。它们的命中可以触发吸血。

strings.english: Glyph damage (Storm, Meteor, Shadowmourne) grows with base health, the run's time and Power, not difficulty. Storm always crits.
strings.translation: 雕文伤害（风暴、陨石、影之哀伤）随基础生命值、远征时长和力量提高，与难度无关。风暴必定造成致命一击。

strings.english: Gear gives its listed stats plus set bonuses.
strings.translation: 装备提供其所列属性以及套装加成。

strings.english: Power, Max Health and Armor grow 12% per tier, compounding, so Tier 20 is about 8.6 times Tier 1. Other stats stay the same.
strings.translation: 力量、最大生命值和护甲每阶提高12%，按复利叠加，因此T20约为T1的8.6倍。其他属性保持不变。

strings.english: Trinket effects don't grow with tier; their stats do.
strings.translation: 饰品的特效不随阶级提高，但其属性会提高。

strings.english: each item you don't extract from a Mythic run gives Scrap, more for higher tiers and bonus stats. Mythic elites drop a little too. strings.english: Damage you take is reduced by Dodge, damage-taken cuts, Armor and then Shield, in that order.
strings.translation: 你受到的伤害会依次经过闪避、伤害减免、护甲和护盾的削减。

strings.english: Dash makes you immune for 0.25 sec.
strings.translation: 冲刺会使你在0.25秒内免疫伤害。

strings.english: Healing orbs heal 20% of maximum health. Each level gained heals 5%.

strings.english: Necrotic, boss wounds and Cursed Ground reduce healing taken, up to 100%.

strings.english: when you die, Glyph of Divine Shield saves you first, then Second Chance, then a Soulstone. A revive restores your health, shields you and destroys normal enemies within 15 yards.
strings.translation: 你死亡时，首先由圣盾术雕文救你，其次是第二次机会，最后是灵魂石。复活会恢复你的生命值，为你施加护盾，并消灭15码内的普通敌人。

fields.translation: 你的致命一击有50%几率为你恢复1%最大生命值，每秒最多3%。

fields.english: Your spells have a 6% chance to cast twice.
fields.translation: 你的法术有6%几率施放两次。

fields.english: +25% damage to elites, mini-bosses and bosses.
fields.translation: 对精英、小首领和首领造成的伤害提高25%。

fields.english: +60% pickup range. Power-ups last twice as long.
fields.translation: 拾取范围提高60%。强化效果的持续时间加倍。

fields.english: Your spells have a 30% chance to cast twice.
fields.translation: 你的法术有30%几率施放两次。

fields.english: +60% pickup range. Power-ups last twice as long.
fields.translation: 拾取范围提高60%。强化效果的持续时间加倍。

fields.english: When an elite, mini-boss or boss dies within 30 yards, heal for 30% of your maximum health.
fields.translation: 当30码内有一个精英、小首领或首领死亡时，为你恢复30%最大生命值。

fields.english: Capture Ley Lines twice as fast. They offer 4 blessings to choose from instead of 3.
fields.translation: 占领魔网的速度加倍。魔网提供的可选祝福由3个增至4个。

fields.english: Your spells have a 30% chance to cast twice.
fields.translation: 你的法术有30%几率施放两次。

fields.english: Every 50 kills, gain 40% Haste for 8 sec.
fields.translation: 每击杀50个敌人，获得40%急速，持续8秒。

fields.english: Fatal damage restores you to full health instead. Once per run, or once every 5 floors on Mythic.
fields.translation: 受到致命伤害时，改为将你的生命值恢复全满。每次远征限一次，史诗难度下改为每5层一次。

fields.english: Every 50 kills, you deal triple damage for 2 sec.
fields.translation: 每击杀50个敌人，你造成的伤害提高至三倍，持续2秒。

fields.english: +2% Power for every 1% of health you are missing.
fields.translation: 你每缺少2%生命值，力量就提高1%。

fields.english: Level-up spell ranks, chest cards and Glyph offers are 1 rarity higher.
fields.translation: 升级时提供的法术等级、宝箱中的卡片以及雕文选项的稀有度提高1级。

fields.english: Every 3 sec, lightning strikes up to 5 nearby enemies for 60% of a normal enemy's health on Normal. Always critically strikes.
fields.translation: 每3秒，闪电会打击最多5个附近敌人，造成相当于普通难度下普通敌人生命值60%的伤害。必定造成致命一击。

fields.english: Every 6 sec, a meteor strikes the largest nearby group of enemies.
fields.translation: 每6秒，一颗陨石砸向附近最大的敌群。

fields.english: +1 dash charge. Reduces the cooldown of your dash by 30%.
fields.translation: 冲刺充能次数增加1次。冲刺的冷却时间缩短30%。
每层额外获得2次重选机会。

fields.english: A chest appears near you every 2 minutes.
fields.translation: 每2分钟，你附近会出现一个宝箱。

fields.english: Elites you kill drop a power-up.
fields.translation: 你击杀的精英会掉落一个强化效果。

fields.english: Your starter spell starts 2 ranks higher and deals 25% more damage.
fields.translation: 你的起手法术初始等级提高2级，造成的伤害提高25%。

fields.english: Whenever mini-bosses appear, 1 more comes. Mini-bosses give double rewards.
fields.translation: 每当小首领出现时，都会额外多出现1个。小首领给予双倍奖励。
小首领造成的伤害提高25%。

fields.english: Twice as many elites, each giving triple experience.
fields.translation: 精英数量加倍，每个精英给予三倍经验值。

fields.english: Below 50% health, +40% Haste and +20% movement speed.
fields.translation: 生命值低于50%时，急速提高40%，移动速度提高20%。

fields.english: Losing health flips it to -25% Power for 5 sec. Shield absorbs don't count.
fields.translation: 受到生命伤害时，该效果反转为力量降低25%，持续5秒。被护盾吸收的伤害不计入。
升级时额外提供1个选项。

fields.english: When an enemy hits you, freeze normal enemies within 10 yards for 2 sec. 15 sec cooldown.
fields.translation: 敌人击中你时，冻结10码内的普通敌人，持续2秒。冷却时间15秒。

fields.english: After you dash, you are immune to damage for 1 sec and your next spell critically strikes.
fields.translation: 冲刺后，你在1秒内免疫伤害，且你的下一个法术必定造成致命一击。

fields.english: Enemies you kill have a 15% chance to explode for 40% of their health to enemies within 6 yards.
fields.translation: 你击杀的敌人有15%几率发生爆炸，对6码内的敌人造成相当于其生命值40%的伤害。

fields.english: Normal enemies below 15% health die instantly. Elites, mini-bosses and bosses below 30% health take 25% more damage.
fields.translation: 生命值低于15%的普通敌人会立即死亡。生命值低于30%的精英、小首领和首领受到的伤害提高25%。

fields.english: Damage beyond a killing blow strikes the nearest enemy within 10 yards.
fields.translation: 最后一击的溢出伤害会打击10码内最近的敌人。
你的法术额外射出1发箭矢。
你的法术造成的伤害降低15%。

fields.english: Spell rank picks have a 25% chance to give 1 additional rank.
fields.translation: 选择法术等级时，有25%几率额外提升1级。

fields.english: Critical strikes apply 2 stacks of Burning.
fields.translation: 致命一击会施加2层燃烧。
每击杀500个敌人，力量提高1%。

fields.english: Every 50 kills, the souls you gathered strike all enemies within 20 yards for 3 times a normal enemy's health on Normal.
fields.translation: 每击杀50个敌人，你收集的灵魂会打击20码内的所有敌人，造成相当于普通难度下普通敌人生命值3倍的伤害。

fields.english: Elites you kill rise as skeletons and fight for you for 20 sec. Up to 5 at a time.
fields.translation: 你击杀的精英会化为骷髅复生，为你而战20秒。最多同时存在5个。

fields.english: Something big was hiding in that bush... it's Hogger!
fields.translation: 那片灌木丛里藏着个大家伙……是霍格！

fields.english: A murloc camp! Old Murk-Eye and his band charge out of the surf!
fields.translation: 一处鱼人营地！老瞎眼和他的手下从浪花中冲了出来！

fields.english: +5.6 Armor. Regain 2.25% of your health every second.
fields.translation: 护甲提高5.6点。每秒恢复2.25%生命值。

fields.english: +33.75% Power, and your hits have a 6.75% chance to heal you for 1% of your maximum health.
fields.translation: 力量提高33.75%，且你的攻击有6.75%几率为你恢复1%最大生命值。

fields.english: Slows the enemy by 3% per stack, up to 30%. At 10 stacks the enemy becomes Frozen. An enemy that can't be Frozen yet stays at 10 stacks. Each new stack refreshes Chill to 4 sec.
fields.translation: 每层使敌人减速3%，最多30%。叠至10层时敌人被冻结。尚不能被冻结的敌人会停留在10层。每层新叠加都会将冰寒的持续时间刷新为4秒。

fields.english: Normal enemies are frozen in place for 2 sec. Elites and bosses keep moving but count as Frozen for those 2 sec. Shatter: your Frost spells always critically strike Frozen enemies, and every critical strike against a Frozen enemy deals an extra 50% damage. After a Freeze, that enemy can't be Frozen again for 6 sec.
fields.translation: 普通敌人被原地冻结2秒。精英和首领仍可移动，但在2秒内视同被冻结。碎裂：你的冰霜法术必定对被冻结的敌人造成致命一击，且对被冻结敌人的每次致命一击额外造成50%的伤害。冻结结束后，该敌人在6秒内无法再次被冻结。

fields.english: Each stack deals Fire damage every tick. Each new stack refreshes all stacks to their full duration, up to 30 stacks. When a burning enemy dies, half of its stacks spread to the 2 nearest enemies within 8 yards.
fields.translation: 每层每跳造成火焰伤害。每叠加新的一层，都会将所有层数的持续时间刷新为完整时长，最多叠加30层。燃烧中的敌人死亡时，其一半的层数会蔓延至8码内最近的2个敌人。

fields.english: Each stack deals Physical damage every tick. Each new stack refreshes all stacks to their full duration, up to 30 stacks. When a bleeding enemy dies, half of its stacks spread to the 2 nearest enemies within 8 yards.
fields.translation: 每层每跳造成物理伤害。每叠加新的一层，都会将所有层数的持续时间刷新为完整时长，最多叠加30层。流血中的敌人死亡时，其一半的层数会蔓延至8码内最近的2个敌人。

fields.english: Each stack deals Nature damage every tick. Each new stack refreshes all stacks to their full duration, up to 30 stacks. When a poisoned enemy dies, half of its stacks spread to the 2 nearest enemies within 8 yards.
fields.translation: 每层每跳造成自然伤害。每叠加新的一层，都会将所有层数的持续时间刷新为完整时长，最多叠加30层。中毒的敌人死亡时，其一半的层数会蔓延至8码内最近的2个敌人。

fields.english: Increases Fire damage taken by 3% per stack. Stacks up to 5 times.
fields.translation: 每层使其受到的火焰伤害提高3%。最多叠加5次。

fields.english: Increases Physical damage taken by 4% per stack. Stacks up to 5 times.
fields.translation: 每层使其受到的物理伤害提高4%。最多叠加5次。

fields.english: Increases Shadow damage taken by 3% per stack. Stacks up to 5 times.
fields.translation: 每层使其受到的暗影伤害提高3%。最多叠加5次。

fields.english: Marked enemies take 15% more damage from you and your summons, raised by the marking spell's ranks and Mark upgrades up to 30%. Talents add on top. When a Marked enemy dies, the Mark passes to the 2 nearest unmarked enemies within 10 yards.
fields.translation: 被标记的敌人受到你和你的召唤物造成的伤害提高15%，施加标记的法术等级和标记强化最多可将其提高至30%。天赋效果在此基础上另行叠加。被标记的敌人死亡时，标记会转移至10码内最近的2个未被标记的敌人。

fields.english: Slows the enemy by 30% for 4 sec.
Stacks up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, the enemy is struck by lightning, dealing Nature damage to it and up to 3 enemies within 6 yards, and the stacks reset.
fields.translation: 最多叠加5次。叠至5层时，闪电会击中该敌人，对其及6码内最多3个敌人造成自然伤害，随后层数重置。

fields.english: Increases Nature damage taken by 4% per stack. Stacks up to 5 times.
fields.translation: 每层使其受到的自然伤害提高4%。最多叠加5次。

fields.english: Each stack deals Shadow damage every tick. Each new stack refreshes all stacks to their full duration, up to 30 stacks. When a decaying enemy dies, half of its stacks spread to the 2 nearest enemies within 8 yards.
fields.translation: 每层每跳造成暗影伤害。每叠加新的一层，都会将所有层数的持续时间刷新为完整时长，最多叠加30层。带有腐朽的敌人死亡时，其一半的层数会蔓延至8码内最近的2个敌人。

fields.english: Each stack deals Shadow damage every tick. A stack's damage grows by a quarter of its starting damage every tick it stays on, up to triple after 8 ticks. One curse per enemy.
fields.translation: 每层每跳造成暗影伤害。每层在敌人身上每停留一跳，伤害就会增加其初始伤害的四分之一，8跳后最多增至三倍。每个敌人身上只能存在一个诅咒。

fields.english: Each stack deals Arcane damage every tick. Each new stack refreshes all stacks to their full duration, up to 30 stacks. When a moonfired enemy dies, half of its stacks spread to the 2 nearest enemies within 8 yards.
fields.translation: 每层每跳造成奥术伤害。每叠加新的一层，都会将所有层数的持续时间刷新为完整时长，最多叠加30层。中了月火术的敌人死亡时，其一半的层数会蔓延至8码内最近的2个敌人。

fields.english: Farmland overrun by the Defias Brotherhood. Edwin VanCleef, Gilnid or Sneed's Shredder leads the floor.
fields.translation: 被迪菲亚兄弟会占据的农田。艾德温·范克里夫、基尔尼格或斯尼德的伐木机坐镇本层。
迪菲亚暴徒、豺狼人、鱼人

fields.english: The burning heart of Blackrock Mountain. Magmadar, Golemagg or Baron Geddon leads the floor, with Garr, Lucifron and Gehennas close behind.
fields.translation: 黑石山燃烧的心脏。玛格曼达、古雷曼格或迦顿男爵坐镇本层，加尔、鲁西弗隆和基赫纳斯紧随其后。

fields.english: Fire elementals, core hounds, Molten Giants
fields.translation: 火焰元素、熔火恶犬、熔火巨人

fields.english: Endless dry plains full of Razormane and Kolkar raiders. Charlga Razorflank, Agathelos the Raging or Mutanus the Devourer leads the floor.
fields.translation: 遍布钢鬃和科卡尔劫掠者的无尽干旱平原。卡尔加·刺肋、暴怒的阿迦赛罗斯或吞噬者穆坦努斯坐镇本层。

fields.english: A dark forest where the dead walk. Stitches, Morbent Fel or Eliza leads the floor.
fields.translation: 亡者横行的黑暗森林。缝合怪、摩本特·费尔或伊莉莎坐镇本层。

fields.english: The temple city of the Gurubashi. Hakkar, High Priest Thekal or Bloodlord Mandokir leads the floor, with Jin'do, Venoxis and Mar'li close behind.
fields.translation: 古拉巴什的神庙之城。哈卡、高阶祭司塞卡尔或血领主曼多基尔坐镇本层，金度、温诺希斯和玛尔里紧随其后。
古拉巴什巨魔、蝙蝠、猛虎

fields.english: The ruined gates of Ahn'Qiraj. Ossirian the Unscarred or Baron Kazum leads the floor.
fields.translation: 安其拉残破的大门。无疤者奥斯里安或卡苏姆男爵坐镇本层。
异种虫群、其拉人、阿努比萨斯

fields.english: Sun-baked dunes around Zul'Farrak. Gahz'rilla or Chief Ukorz Sandscalp leads the floor.
fields.translation: 祖尔法拉克周围烈日炙烤的沙丘。加兹瑞拉或乌克兹·沙顶坐镇本层。
土狼、食人魔、废土流浪者强盗

fields.english: A primal crater ruled by giant beasts. King Mosh or the Gorishi Hive Queen leads the floor.
fields.translation: 巨兽统治的原始环形山。暴龙之王摩什或格里什皇后坐镇本层。

fields.english: Thick jungle full of Bloodscalp and Skullsplitter trolls. The Mosh'Ogg Lord or Gan'zulah leads the floor.
fields.translation: 遍布血顶和劈颅巨魔的茂密丛林。莫什奥格领主或甘祖拉恩坐镇本层。

fields.english: A barren land of warring centaur clans. Princess Theradras, Celebras the Cursed or Rotgrip leads the floor.
fields.translation: 半人马部族彼此征战的荒凉大地。瑟莱德丝公主、被诅咒的塞雷布拉斯或洛特格里普坐镇本层。

fields.english: Scorched canyons above Uldaman. Archaedas, the Ancient Stone Keeper or the Obsidian Sentinel leads the floor.
fields.translation: 奥达曼上方焦灼的峡谷。阿扎达斯、古代的石头看守者或黑曜石哨兵坐镇本层。

fields.english: Rolling highlands held by ogres and outlaws. Fozruk or Prince Nazjak leads the floor.
fields.translation: 被食人魔和亡命之徒占据的连绵高地。弗兹鲁克或纳兹加克王子坐镇本层。
食人魔、枯木巨魔、辛迪加

fields.english: A sunken swamp around the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. The Avatar of Hakkar, Jammal'an the Prophet or Morphaz leads the floor.
fields.translation: 环绕阿塔哈卡神庙的沉陷沼泽。哈卡的化身、预言者迦玛兰或摩弗拉斯坐镇本层。

fields.english: Ash and fire below Blackrock Spire. Emperor Thaurissan and General Drakkisath lead the floors.
fields.translation: 黑石塔下的灰烬与烈焰。索瑞森大帝和达基萨斯将军分别坐镇各层。

fields.english: The heart of the plague, below Stratholme. Baron Rivendare and Balnazzar lead the floors.
fields.translation: 斯坦索姆城下的瘟疫中心。瑞文戴尔男爵和巴纳扎尔分别坐镇各层。

fields.english: Fields between Scholomance and the Scarlet camps. Darkmaster Gandling, Jandice Barov or Doctor Theolen Krastinov leads the floor.
fields.translation: 通灵学院与血色十字军营地之间的田野。黑暗院长加丁、詹迪斯·巴罗夫或瑟尔林·卡斯迪诺夫教授坐镇本层。
血色十字军、食尸鬼、瘟疫野兽

fields.english: Ancient forests around Dire Maul. King Gordok and Prince Tortheldrin lead the floors.
fields.translation: 厄运之槌周围的古老森林。戈多克大王和托塞德林王子分别坐镇各层。
豺狼人、食人魔、厄运之槌

fields.english: Molten slag pits at the foot of Blackrock Mountain. Rend Blackhand and The Beast lead the floors.
fields.translation: 黑石山脚下熔融的矿渣坑。雷德·黑手和比斯巨兽分别坐镇各层。

fields.english: Dark Iron dwarves, golems, lava spiders
fields.translation: 黑铁矮人、魔像、熔岩蜘蛛

fields.english: A corrupted forest full of demons. Lord Kazzak and Kroshius lead the floors.
fields.translation: 恶魔横行的腐化森林。卡扎克和克罗苏斯分别坐镇各层。

fields.english: The frozen shore of Iceflow Lake below Gnomeregan. Troggs and trolls come first, then Mekgineer Thermaplugg or the Dark Iron Ambassador and his machines.
fields.translation: 诺莫瑞根之下冰流湖的冰封湖岸。穴居人和巨魔先行，麦克尼尔·瑟玛普拉格或黑铁大使及其机器随后登场。
穴居人、霜鬃巨魔、诺莫瑞根
武器系法术造成的伤害提高5%。

fields.english: Free. Rend is a starter spell.

fields.translation: 你的流血造成的伤害提高12%。

fields.english: Mortal Strike deals 1% more damage per Bleed stack on the target.
fields.translation: 致死打击的伤害随目标身上的每层流血提高1%。

fields.english: Cleave applies Bleed to every enemy it hits. Can't be learned with Sudden Death.
fields.translation: 顺劈斩会对其命中的所有敌人施加流血。不能与猝死同时学习。

fields.english: When Mortal Strike kills an enemy, its cooldown resets. Can't be learned with Blood Frenzy.
fields.translation: 致死打击击杀敌人时，其冷却时间会重置。不能与狂血同时学习。

fields.english: Your critical strikes deal 10% more damage.
fields.translation: 你的致命一击造成的伤害提高10%。

fields.english: Every 3rd cast of each spell critically strikes every enemy it hits, and those critical strikes deal 25% more damage.
fields.translation: 每个法术每施放3次，第3次会对其命中的所有敌人造成致命一击，且这些致命一击造成的伤害提高25%。

fields.english: Your critical strikes deal 10% more damage.
fields.translation: 你的致命一击造成的伤害提高10%。
武器系法术造成的伤害提高4%。

fields.english: Mortal Strike applies 1 stack of Bleed to each enemy it hits.
fields.translation: 致死打击会对其命中的每个敌人施加1层流血。

fields.english: Deep Wounds applies 1 additional stack of Bleed.
Deep Wounds can wound each enemy 50% more often.
fields.translation: 重伤对每个敌人的触发频率提高50%。

fields.english: Your Bleed can critically strike for half the critical strike bonus.
fields.translation: 你的流血可以造成致命一击，但致命一击的伤害加成减半。

fields.english: Increases the radius of Mortal Strike by 2 yards.
fields.translation: 致死打击的作用半径增加2码。

fields.english: Each Bleeding enemy that dies gives +1% Power for 8 sec, stacking up to 10 times.
fields.translation: 每有一个流血的敌人死亡，你的力量提高1%，持续8秒，最多叠加10次。

fields.english: Mortal Strike deals double damage to enemies with 10 or more Bleed stacks.
fields.translation: 致死打击对流血层数达到10层或以上的敌人造成双倍伤害。

fields.english: Mortal Strike slows normal enemies by 30% for 2 sec.
fields.translation: 致死打击使普通敌人减速30%，持续2秒。
狂怒系法术造成的伤害提高5%。

fields.english: Free. Cleave is a starter spell.
fields.translation: 免费。顺劈斩是起手法术。

fields.english: Regain 0.2% of your health every second.

fields.translation: 狂怒状态提供的急速提高5%。

fields.english: +15% damage while Enraged. Can't be learned with Improved Execute.
fields.translation: 狂怒状态下造成的伤害提高15%。不能与强化斩杀同时学习。

fields.english: Execute kills normal enemies below 25% health, up from 20%. Can't be learned with Death Wish.
fields.translation: 斩杀可直接击杀生命值低于25%的普通敌人（原为20%）。不能与死亡之愿同时学习。

fields.english: You are always Enraged. Enrage gives 50% more Haste, and talents that improve Enrage are 50% stronger. You take 15% more damage.
