fields.translation: 进化选项允许你选择该法术的任意进化方向。
远征中获得的经验值提高5%。

fields.english: Evolutions can be offered 1 rank earlier.

fields.translation: 受到的治疗效果降低50%。金币提高20%。

fields.english: The floor boss arrives 60 sec earlier. +15% gold.
fields.translation: 楼层首领提前60秒到来。金币提高15%。
精英额外带有1个词缀。金币提高20%。
暗月卡片禁用栏位增加1个。
远征中获得的金币和废料+3%。

fields.english: One floor in wide-open lands. Beat its boss to win the run.
fields.translation: 在开阔的地带挑战一层。击败该层首领即可赢得远征。

fields.english: Bosses lead their spells slightly.^Elites have 1 affix.
fields.translation: 首领的法术略有预判。^精英带有1个词缀。

fields.english: Climb floor by floor against the deadliest foes. Each floor is tougher and pays more; past floor 20 the climb goes on. Gives 100% more Mastery experience.
fields.translation: 逐层攀升，迎战最致命的强敌。每一层都更加艰难，回报也更丰厚；过了第20层，攀升仍将继续。获得的专精经验值提高100%。

fields.english: Enemies have 220% more health and deal 60% more damage, more on every floor.^Casters lead their shots precisely.^Bosses lead their spells precisely and get even more attacks.^25% of enemies are Veterans: tougher and worth more.^Elites have 3 affixes. Chargers charge more often.
fields.translation: 敌人的生命值提高220%，造成的伤害提高60%，且每层还会继续提高。^施法者的射击会精确预判。^首领的法术会精确预判，并获得更多攻击手段。^25%的敌人是老兵：更强悍，奖励也更高。^精英带有3个词缀。冲锋者冲锋更频繁。

fields.english: Two floors in rougher lands, with tougher foes, better loot, more Darkmoon Tickets and 50% more Mastery experience.
fields.translation: 在更凶险的地带挑战两层，敌人更强，战利品更好，暗月奖券更多，专精经验值提高50%。

fields.english: Enemies have 60% more health and deal 30% more damage.^Casters lead their shots slightly more accurately.^Bosses lead their spells more and get extra attacks.^15% of enemies are Veterans: tougher and worth more.^Elites have 2 affixes. Chargers charge more often.
fields.translation: 敌人的生命值提高60%，造成的伤害提高30%。^施法者的射击预判更准一些。^首领的法术预判更多，并获得额外的攻击手段。^15%的敌人是老兵：更强悍，奖励也更高。^精英带有2个词缀。冲锋者冲锋更频繁。

fields.english: Chests and vendor wares cost 4% less Valor.
fields.translation: 开箱和购买商人物品消耗的勇气点数降低4%。
拆解装备获得的勇气点数提高10%。
宝箱额外提供1张暗月卡片。
升级时额外提供1个选项。

fields.english: +2 sec on timed events, such as treasure goblins and bounties.
fields.translation: 限时事件（如财宝地精和赏金）的时间延长2秒。

fields.english: +8% Ley Line capture speed and +8% Moonwell duration.
fields.translation: 魔网占领速度提高8%，月亮井持续时间提高8%。

fields.english: +20% Hearthstone find chance. Stand in its ring 1 sec less.
fields.translation: 炉石的出现几率提高20%。站入其法环所需的时间缩短1秒。

fields.english: +1 starting level in runs, with its level-up choice.
fields.translation: 远征开始时等级提高1级，并获得对应的升级选项。

fields.english: Runs start with a random common Darkmoon Card (uncommon at rank 2).
fields.translation: 远征开始时随机获得一张普通品质的暗月卡片（等级2时为优秀品质）。

fields.english: +1 Extraction Vault slot. The Hearthstone's vault still holds 1.
fields.translation: 提取保险库的容量增加1格。炉石的保险库仍只有1格。

fields.english: Choose an extra Glyph at the start of every run.
fields.translation: 每次远征开始时可额外选择一个雕文。

fields.english: Zixil can restock 1 more time per visit.
fields.translation: 吉克希尔每次造访时可以多补货1次。

fields.english: Shoots the nearest enemy for Arcane damage.
fields.translation: 射击最近的敌人，造成奥术伤害。

fields.english: Fires 6 arrows in a cone in front of you, dealing damage.
fields.translation: 向前方锥形范围内射出6支箭，造成伤害。

fields.english: Stings the nearest enemy and 2 enemies near it with 3 stacks of Poison.
fields.translation: 钉刺最近的敌人及其附近的2个敌人，施加3层中毒。

fields.english: Rains arrows on the largest group of enemies for 4 sec, dealing damage, 5% more for each different debuff on the target.
fields.translation: 向最大的敌群倾泻箭雨，持续4秒并造成伤害，目标身上每种不同的减益效果都使伤害提高5%。

fields.english: Summons your cat to fight for you. Its Claw applies Bleed, and its Swipe hits every enemy in front of it.
fields.translation: 召唤你的猫为你而战。它的爪击会施加流血，横扫会命中其前方的所有敌人。

fields.english: Places a fire trap that explodes when an enemy comes close, dealing damage and burning the ground for 4 sec, applying Burning.
fields.translation: 放置一个火焰陷阱，在敌人靠近时爆炸，造成伤害并灼烧地面4秒，施加燃烧。

fields.english: Fires a shot that pierces every enemy in a line, dealing damage. Aims at the Marked group, or else the largest group.
fields.translation: 发射一发贯穿直线上所有敌人的射击，造成伤害。优先瞄准被标记的敌群，其次瞄准最大的敌群。

fields.english: Places a frost trap that goes off when an enemy comes close, slowing normal enemies inside by 60% for 6 sec. They take 5% more damage.
fields.translation: 放置一个冰霜陷阱，在敌人靠近时触发，使范围内的普通敌人减速60%，持续6秒。它们受到的伤害提高5%。

fields.english: Marks every enemy within 10 yards of the largest group for 8 sec. Marked enemies take 15% more damage.
fields.translation: 标记最大的敌群周围10码内的所有敌人，持续8秒。被标记的敌人受到的伤害提高15%。

fields.english: A spirit wolf fights for you, biting for damage. Every 15 sec it howls, and your other pets deal double damage to all enemies in front for 6 sec.
fields.translation: 一只灵魂之狼为你而战，撕咬造成伤害。它会每隔15秒嚎叫一次，使你的其他宠物对前方所有敌人造成的伤害翻倍，持续6秒。

fields.english: Shoots the nearest enemy for Arcane damage and consumes all Poison on it, dealing the remaining Poison damage at once.
fields.translation: 射击最近的敌人，造成奥术伤害，并消耗其身上所有中毒效果，立即造成剩余的毒性伤害。

fields.english: Shoots the nearest enemy for Arcane damage, then jumps to 2 more enemies within 10 yards, Marked enemies first. Each jump deals 25% more than the last.
fields.translation: 射击最近的敌人，造成奥术伤害，然后弹向10码内的2个敌人，被标记的敌人优先。每跳伤害比上一跳提高25%。

fields.english: Fires 3 arrows in a cone in front of you, dealing damage. Each enemy they kill fires 3 arrows at the nearest enemies within 15 yards, and those kills fire again.
fields.translation: 向前方锥形范围内射出3支箭，造成伤害。被射杀的每个敌人会向15码内最近的敌人再射出3支箭，被射杀的目标还会继续触发。

fields.english: Fires 3 arrows in a cone in front of you, dealing damage and applying 2 stacks of Poison.
fields.translation: 向前方锥形范围内射出3支箭，造成伤害并施加2层中毒。

fields.english: Fires a shot that pierces every enemy in a line, dealing damage. Aims at the Marked group, or else the largest group. Each enemy pierced then explodes in turn for 40% of the damage within 4 yards.
fields.translation: 发射一发贯穿直线上所有敌人的射击，造成伤害。优先瞄准被标记的敌群，其次瞄准最大的敌群。被贯穿的每个敌人会依次爆炸，对其4码内的敌人造成40%的伤害。

fields.english: Fires a shot that pierces every enemy in a line, dealing damage. Aims at the Marked group, or else the largest group. Standing still makes it attack twice as often and its line 100% wider each sec, up to 3 times as wide.
fields.translation: 发射一发贯穿直线上所有敌人的射击，造成伤害。优先瞄准被标记的敌群，其次瞄准最大的敌群。站立不动时，其攻击频率翻倍，射线宽度每秒增加100%，最多可达3倍宽。

fields.english: Rains arrows on the largest group of enemies for 3 sec, dealing damage, 5% more for each different debuff on the target. The storm follows the largest group within 25 yards.
fields.translation: 向最大的敌群倾泻箭雨，持续3秒并造成伤害，目标身上每种不同的减益效果都使伤害提高5%。风暴会跟随25码内最大的敌群移动。

fields.english: Pulls every normal enemy within 12 yards of the largest group into the middle, then rains arrows on them for 3 sec, dealing damage, 5% more for each different debuff on the target. Elites and bosses resist the pull.
fields.translation: 将最大的敌群周围12码内的所有普通敌人拉向中央，然后向他们倾泻箭雨，持续3秒并造成伤害，目标身上每种不同的减益效果都使伤害提高5%。精英和首领不受牵引影响。

fields.english: Marks every enemy within 10 yards of the largest group for 8 sec. Marked enemies take 15% more damage. For 6 sec, your shots that hit an enemy there fire 1 additional shot at another enemy there.
fields.translation: 标记最大的敌群周围10码内的所有敌人，持续8秒。被标记的敌人受到的伤害提高15%。在6秒内，你的射击命中该区域的敌人时，会额外向该区域的另一个敌人射出1发。

fields.english: Marks every enemy within 10 yards of the largest group for 8 sec. Marked enemies take 15% more damage and burst on death, dealing Arcane damage to enemies within 8 yards.
fields.translation: 标记最大的敌群周围10码内的所有敌人，持续8秒。被标记的敌人受到的伤害提高15%，死亡时爆裂，对其8码内的敌人造成奥术伤害。

fields.english: Stings the nearest enemy and 2 enemies near it with 3 stacks of Poison. Poisoned enemies that die fire 3 venom arrows at enemies within 12 yards, each applying 2 stacks of Poison.
fields.translation: 钉刺最近的敌人及其附近的2个敌人，施加3层中毒。中毒的敌人死亡时会向12码内的敌人射出3支毒箭，每支施加2层中毒。

fields.english: Stings the nearest enemy and 2 enemies near it with 3 stacks of Poison. Poisoned enemies that die leave a venom cloud for 2 sec that adds 1 stack of Poison every 0.5 sec to enemies within 4 yards.
fields.translation: 钉刺最近的敌人及其附近的2个敌人，施加3层中毒。中毒的敌人死亡时会留下一团毒云，持续2秒，每0.5秒对其4码内的敌人施加1层中毒。

fields.english: Places a fire trap that explodes when an enemy comes close, dealing damage and burning the ground for 4 sec, applying Burning. It also scatters 5 bomblets that explode for 40% damage within 3 yards, applying Burning.
fields.translation: 放置一个火焰陷阱，在敌人靠近时爆炸，造成伤害并灼烧地面4秒，施加燃烧。同时散布5枚子炸弹，在3码内以40%的伤害爆炸，施加燃烧。

fields.english: Places a trap that releases 6 venomous snakes when an enemy comes close. They bite nearby enemies for 8 sec, each bite applying 2 stacks of Poison. The snakes count as your pets.
fields.translation: 放置一个陷阱，在敌人靠近时放出6条毒蛇。它们会撕咬附近的敌人，持续8秒，每次撕咬施加2层中毒。这些毒蛇算作你的宠物。

fields.english: Places a frost trap that goes off when an enemy comes close, slowing normal enemies inside by 60% for 6 sec. They take 5% more damage, and when the ice fades it shatters, dealing Frost damage to every enemy inside.
fields.translation: 放置一个冰霜陷阱，在敌人靠近时触发，使范围内的普通敌人减速60%，持续6秒，受到的伤害提高5%。寒冰消散时会碎裂，对范围内的所有敌人造成冰霜伤害。

fields.english: Ice follows you for 6 sec. Normal enemies within 6 yards of you are slowed by 60% and take 5% more damage.
fields.translation: 寒冰随你移动6秒。你6码内的普通敌人减速60%，受到的伤害提高5%。

fields.english: Summons your cat to fight for you. Its Claw applies Bleed. Every 20 sec, 3 spectral beasts charge through the largest group of enemies, hitting every enemy they pass.
fields.translation: 召唤你的猫为你而战。它的爪击会施加流血。每隔20秒，3头幽灵野兽会冲过最大的敌群，撞倒沿途的所有敌人。

fields.english: Summons an undead beast to fight for you. Its Claw applies 2 stacks of Poison, and its plague cloud adds 1 stack of Poison every sec to enemies within 5 yards.
fields.translation: 召唤一头亡灵野兽为你而战。它的爪击会施加2层中毒，其瘟疫之云每秒对5码内的敌人施加1层中毒。

fields.english: A spirit wolf fights for you, biting for damage. Every 15 sec it howls: your other pets deal double damage to all enemies in front for 6 sec, and a Boar, Bear or Wyvern joins for 8 sec. The Boar charges through the largest group, the Bear mauls and leaves enemies bleeding, the Wyvern makes your pets deal 20% more damage.
fields.translation: 一只灵魂之狼为你而战，撕咬造成伤害。它会每隔15秒嚎叫一次：使你的其他宠物对前方所有敌人造成的伤害翻倍，持续6秒，并有一头野猪、熊或双足飞龙加入，持续8秒。野猪会冲撞最大的敌群，熊会重击并使敌人流血，双足飞龙使你的宠物造成的伤害提高20%。

fields.english: A spirit wolf fights for you, biting for damage. Every 15 sec it howls: your other pets deal double damage to all enemies in front for 6 sec. Each kill your pets make meanwhile adds 0.5 sec, up to 10 sec left.
fields.translation: 一只灵魂之狼为你而战，撕咬造成伤害。它会每隔15秒嚎叫一次：使你的其他宠物对前方所有敌人造成的伤害翻倍，持续6秒。期间你的宠物每击杀一个敌人，效果延长0.5秒，最多延长至10秒。

fields.english: Strikes all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。

fields.english: Wounds the 3 nearest enemies within 10 yards with 3 stacks of Bleed.
fields.translation: 使10码内最近的3个敌人受伤，施加3层流血。

fields.english: Your critical strikes wound the enemy with 2 stacks of Bleed, at most once every 0.5 sec per enemy.
fields.translation: 你的致命一击会使敌人受伤，施加2层流血，每个敌人每0.5秒至多触发一次。

fields.english: Strikes all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage, 8% more per stack of Bleed on the target, up to 30 stacks.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害，目标每层流血使伤害提高8%，最多计算30层。

fields.english: Strikes the 3 nearest enemies within 8 yards for damage and heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 2.5%. Critical strikes Enrage you: 25% Haste for 4 sec.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内最近的3个敌人，造成伤害，并每命中一个敌人为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，最多2.5%。致命一击会使你进入狂怒状态：急速提高25%，持续4秒。

fields.english: Strikes all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage. Normal enemies below 20% health die instantly; elites and bosses below 20% take triple damage. Kills Enrage you: 25% Haste for 4 sec.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。生命值低于20%的普通敌人立即死亡；生命值低于20%的精英和首领受到三倍伤害。击杀会使你进入狂怒状态：急速提高25%，持续4秒。

fields.english: Spins, striking all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage. Spins twice while you are Enraged.
fields.translation: 旋转并打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。你处于狂怒状态时会旋转两次。

fields.english: Adds a Shield of 10% of your maximum health that lasts until it absorbs damage, stacking up to 50%.
fields.translation: 获得一层护盾，可吸收相当于10%最大生命值的伤害，存留直至吸收伤害，最多叠加至50%。

fields.english: Blasts all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage. Enemies hit attack 20% slower for 6 sec.
fields.translation: 轰击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。被击中的敌人攻击速度降低20%，持续6秒。

fields.english: When you are struck, strikes all enemies within 6 yards of you for damage, at most once every 2 sec.
fields.translation: 当你受到攻击时，打击你6码内的所有敌人，造成伤害，每2秒至多触发一次。

fields.english: Slams all enemies within 6 yards of you for damage, 2% more for each 1% of your maximum health in your Shield, up to 200% more.
fields.translation: 猛击你6码内的所有敌人，造成伤害，你的护盾每相当于2%最大生命值，伤害提高1%，最多提高200%。

fields.english: Strikes all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage. Each swing leaves an echo that strikes again 1 sec later.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。每次挥击都会留下一道刀锋残影，在1秒后再次打击。

fields.english: Strikes all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage. Every 4th swing reaches 12 yards and knocks normal enemies back.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。每第4次挥击可延伸至12码，并击退普通敌人。

fields.english: All enemies within 8 yards of you gain 2 stacks of Bleed.
fields.translation: 你8码内的所有敌人获得2层流血。

fields.english: Wounds the 3 nearest enemies within 10 yards with 3 stacks of Bleed. Bleeding enemies that die leave a pool of blood for 4 sec that adds 1 stack of Bleed every sec to enemies within 4 yards.
fields.translation: 使10码内最近的3个敌人受伤，施加3层流血。流血的敌人死亡时会留下一池鲜血，持续4秒，每秒对4码内的敌人施加1层流血。

fields.english: Your critical strikes wound the enemy and every enemy within 4 yards of it with 2 stacks of Bleed, at most once every 0.5 sec per enemy.
fields.translation: 你的致命一击会使敌人及其4码内的所有敌人受伤，施加2层流血，每个敌人每0.5秒至多触发一次。

fields.english: Your critical strikes wound the enemy with 2 stacks of Bleed, at most once every 0.5 sec per enemy. Each time this Bleed deals damage, it deals 10% more, up to triple.
fields.translation: 你的致命一击会使敌人受伤，施加2层流血，每个敌人每0.5秒至多触发一次。该流血效果每造成一次伤害，其伤害就提高10%，最多提高至三倍。

fields.english: Strikes all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage, 8% more per stack of Bleed on the target, up to 30 stacks. Each Bleeding enemy hit reduces its cooldown by 0.5 sec, up to 1 sec per strike, to a minimum of 3 sec.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害，目标每层流血使伤害提高8%，最多计算30层。每击中一个流血的敌人，此法术的冷却时间缩短0.5秒，每次打击最多缩短1秒，冷却时间最低为3秒。

fields.english: Strikes all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage, 8% more per stack of Bleed on the target, up to 30 stacks. 1.5 sec later the ground erupts for 30% of that damage and 1 stack of Bleed within 8 yards.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害，目标每层流血使伤害提高8%，最多计算30层。1.5秒后地面喷发，对8码内的敌人造成30%的伤害并施加1层流血。

fields.english: Strikes the 3 nearest enemies within 8 yards for damage and heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 2.5%. Healing past full health becomes a Blood Shield that explodes for 200% damage within 8 yards when it breaks.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内最近的3个敌人，造成伤害，并每命中一个敌人为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，最多2.5%。溢出满生命值的治疗会转化为血盾，破碎时对8码内的敌人造成200%的伤害。

fields.english: Strikes the 3 nearest enemies within 8 yards for damage and heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 2.5%. Below 50% health it strikes all enemies within 8 yards instead and heals up to 4%.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内最近的3个敌人，造成伤害，并每命中一个敌人为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，最多2.5%。生命值低于50%时，改为打击你8码内的所有敌人，治疗量最多为4%。

fields.english: Strikes all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage. Normal enemies below 20% health die instantly; elites and bosses below 20% take triple damage. Its kills explode for 50% damage within 5 yards, executing normal enemies left below 20%. Kills Enrage you.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。生命值低于20%的普通敌人立即死亡；生命值低于20%的精英和首领受到三倍伤害。被击杀的敌人会爆炸，对5码内的敌人造成50%的伤害，并斩杀其中生命值低于20%的普通敌人。击杀会使你进入狂怒状态。

fields.english: Strikes all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage; elites and bosses below 20% health take triple damage. Every normal enemy within 40 yards below 20% health dies instantly. Kills Enrage you: 25% Haste for 4 sec.
fields.translation: 打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害；生命值低于20%的精英和首领受到三倍伤害。40码内所有生命值低于20%的普通敌人立即死亡。击杀会使你进入狂怒状态：急速提高25%，持续4秒。

fields.english: Spins for 3 sec while you keep moving, striking all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage every 0.5 sec. Haste makes it strike more often. Starting it while Enraged makes the spin last 50% longer.
fields.translation: 持续旋转3秒，期间你可以继续移动，每0.5秒打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。急速越高，打击越频繁。在狂怒状态下发动时，旋转持续时间延长50%。

fields.english: Spins, striking all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage; twice while you are Enraged. Each spin leaves a storm of blades for 3 sec that strikes enemies within 8 yards for 20% damage every 0.5 sec.
fields.translation: 旋转并打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害；你处于狂怒状态时会旋转两次。每次旋转都会留下一场刀刃风暴，持续3秒，每0.5秒对8码内的敌人造成20%的伤害。

fields.english: Adds a Shield of 10% of your maximum health that lasts until it absorbs damage. Each hit it absorbs sends out a shockwave, dealing damage to all enemies within 8 yards of you, at most once every 0.5 sec.
fields.translation: 获得一层护盾，可吸收相当于10%最大生命值的伤害，存留直至吸收伤害。护盾每吸收一次攻击就会发出一道冲击波，对你8码内的所有敌人造成伤害，每0.5秒至多触发一次。

fields.english: Adds a Shield of 10% of your maximum health that lasts until it absorbs damage. While you hold any Shield, spikes strike all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage every sec.
fields.translation: 获得一层护盾，可吸收相当于10%最大生命值的伤害，存留直至吸收伤害。只要你持有任意护盾，尖刺就会每秒打击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。

fields.english: Blasts all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage, set off by your other spells instead of a cooldown. Enemies hit attack 20% slower for 6 sec. Haste lowers how many casts it needs, down to 4.
fields.translation: 轰击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害，由你的其他法术触发而非冷却时间。被击中的敌人攻击速度降低20%，持续6秒。急速会降低触发所需的施法次数，最低为4次。

fields.english: Blasts all enemies within 8 yards of you for damage. Enemies hit attack 20% slower and deal 20% less damage for 6 sec. Heals you for 0.3% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 2%.
fields.translation: 轰击你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。被击中的敌人攻击速度降低20%，造成的伤害降低20%，持续6秒。每命中一个敌人为你恢复0.3%最大生命值，最多2%。

fields.english: When you are struck, strikes all enemies within 6 yards of you for damage, at most once every 2 sec. Health damage you take is stored, up to 50% of your maximum health, and adds up to 200% damage to the next strike.
fields.translation: 当你受到攻击时，打击你6码内的所有敌人，造成伤害，每2秒至多触发一次。你受到的生命伤害会被储存，最多储存50%最大生命值，并使下一次打击的伤害提高，最多提高200%。

fields.english: When you are struck, strikes all enemies within 6 yards of you for damage and Enrages you (25% Haste for 4 sec), at most once every 2 sec.
fields.translation: 当你受到攻击时，打击你6码内的所有敌人，造成伤害，并使你进入狂怒状态（急速提高25%，持续4秒），每2秒至多触发一次。

fields.english: Hurls your shield at the nearest enemy within 20 yards for damage. It jumps to 5 more enemies within 10 yards, never the same one twice. Deals 2% more damage for each 1% of your maximum health in your Shield, up to 200% more.
fields.translation: 将你的盾牌掷向20码内最近的敌人，造成伤害。盾牌会弹向10码内的5个敌人，绝不重复命中同一目标。你的护盾每相当于2%最大生命值，伤害提高1%，最多提高200%。

fields.english: Slams all enemies within 6 yards of you for damage, 2% more for each 1% of your maximum health in your Shield, up to 200% more. Each enemy hit adds 1% of your maximum health to your Shield, up to 10% per slam.
fields.translation: 猛击你6码内的所有敌人，造成伤害，你的护盾每相当于2%最大生命值，伤害提高1%，最多提高200%。每击中一个敌人就为你的护盾增加1%最大生命值，每次猛击最多增加10%。

fields.english: Launches a bolt of frost at the nearest enemy, dealing Frost damage and applying 1 stack of Chill. Deals 50% more to Frozen enemies, and your Frost spells always critically strike them.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人掷出一枚冰霜箭，造成冰霜伤害并施加1层冰寒。对已冻结的敌人造成的伤害提高50%，且你的冰霜法术必定对其造成致命一击。

fields.english: Ice shards pelt the largest group of enemies for 4 sec, dealing Frost damage and applying 1 stack of Chill every sec.
fields.translation: 冰片轰击最大的敌群，持续4秒，造成冰霜伤害并每秒施加1层冰寒。

fields.english: Blasts all enemies within 10 yards of you with frost, dealing Frost damage and applying 3 stacks of Chill.
fields.translation: 以寒霜轰击你10码内的所有敌人，造成冰霜伤害并施加3层冰寒。

fields.english: Hurls a fiery ball at the nearest enemy, dealing Fire damage and applying 2 stacks of Burning.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人掷出一个火球，造成火焰伤害并施加2层燃烧。

fields.english: Calls down a pillar of fire on the largest group of enemies, dealing Fire damage and applying 2 stacks of Burning.
fields.translation: 在最大的敌群上空召唤一根火柱，造成火焰伤害并施加2层燃烧。

fields.english: Hurls a huge fireball at an elite or boss, or else the largest group, dealing heavy Fire damage to the target and 35% of it to enemies within 6 yards.
fields.translation: 向一个精英或首领掷出巨型火球，若没有则掷向最大的敌群，对目标造成高额火焰伤害，并对其6码内的敌人造成35%的伤害。

fields.english: Blasts the 3 enemies with the most Burning, dealing Fire damage, 10% more per Burning stack, up to 30 stacks.
fields.translation: 轰击燃烧层数最多的3个敌人，造成火焰伤害，每层燃烧使伤害提高10%，最多计算30层。

fields.english: Your dash becomes Blink, teleporting you, with 1 additional charge and a 30% shorter cooldown. Each Blink sets off an Arcane Explosion where you leave, dealing Arcane damage to enemies within 10 yards. Takes a spell slot.
fields.translation: 你的冲刺变为闪现术，使你瞬间传送，充能次数增加1次，冷却时间缩短30%。每次闪现都会在你离开的位置引发一次奥术爆炸，对10码内的敌人造成奥术伤害。占用一个法术槽位。

fields.english: Blasts all enemies within 10 yards of you with arcane energy, dealing Arcane damage. Also goes off where you land after each Blink.
fields.translation: 以奥术能量轰击你10码内的所有敌人，造成奥术伤害。每次闪现落地的位置也会引发爆炸。

fields.english: Launches 5 Arcane Missiles at the nearest enemy over 1 sec, each dealing Arcane damage. After each Blink, it fires all 5 at once.
fields.translation: 在1秒内向最近的敌人发射5枚奥术飞弹，每枚造成奥术伤害。每次闪现术后，会一次性发射全部5枚。

fields.english: Summons an elemental to fight for you, following the school most of your spells belong to.
fields.translation: 召唤一个元素为你而战，其类型与你大多数法术所属的派系一致。

fields.english: Launches a bolt of frost at the nearest enemy, dealing Frost damage and applying 1 stack of Chill, 50% more to Frozen enemies. It then jumps to the next Frozen enemy within 12 yards, up to 6 times. Your Frost spells always critically strike Frozen enemies.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人掷出一枚冰霜箭，造成冰霜伤害并施加1层冰寒，对已冻结的敌人造成的伤害提高50%。随后它会弹向12码内下一个已冻结的敌人，最多弹射6次。你的冰霜法术必定对已冻结的敌人造成致命一击。

fields.english: Launches a bolt of frost at the nearest enemy, dealing Frost damage and applying 1 stack of Chill, 50% more to Frozen enemies. A bolt that hits a Frozen enemy shatters it, hitting enemies within 5 yards for the same damage. Your Frost spells always critically strike Frozen enemies.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人掷出一枚冰霜箭，造成冰霜伤害并施加1层冰寒，对已冻结的敌人造成的伤害提高50%。命中已冻结敌人的冰霜箭会将其震碎，对5码内的敌人造成等量伤害。你的冰霜法术必定对已冻结的敌人造成致命一击。

fields.english: Ice shards pelt the largest group of enemies for 4 sec, dealing Frost damage and applying 1 stack of Chill every sec. Normal enemies Frozen inside stay Frozen until it ends.
fields.translation: 冰片轰击最大的敌群，持续4秒，造成冰霜伤害并每秒施加1层冰寒。在其中被冻结的普通敌人将持续冻结直至效果结束。

fields.english: Ice shards pelt the largest group of enemies for 4 sec, dealing Frost damage and applying 1 stack of Chill every sec. Each time an enemy is Frozen inside, it loses 15% of its maximum health (elites 5%, bosses 1%).
fields.translation: 冰片轰击最大的敌群，持续4秒，造成冰霜伤害并每秒施加1层冰寒。每当有敌人被冻结在其中，就会损失15%最大生命值（精英为5%，首领为1%）。

fields.english: Frost bursts around your last Frostbolt target, or the nearest enemy within 30 yards, dealing Frost damage and applying 3 stacks of Chill to enemies within 10 yards of it.
fields.translation: 寒霜在你上一个寒冰箭目标周围爆发，若目标已消失则改为30码内最近的敌人，造成冰霜伤害并对其10码内的敌人施加3层冰寒。

fields.english: Blasts all enemies within 10 yards of you with frost, dealing Frost damage and applying 3 stacks of Chill. Each enemy it Freezes adds a Shield of 1% of your maximum health, up to 15% per cast.
fields.translation: 以寒霜轰击你10码内的所有敌人，造成冰霜伤害并施加3层冰寒。每冻结一个敌人就获得一层护盾，可吸收1%最大生命值的伤害，每次施法最多叠加至15%。

fields.english: Hurls a fiery ball at the nearest enemy, dealing Fire damage and applying 2 stacks of Burning. For 6 sec while the target lives, its Burning jumps to a nearby enemy that isn't burning every sec.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人掷出一个火球，造成火焰伤害并施加2层燃烧。在目标存活的6秒内，其燃烧效果每秒会跳向附近一个未燃烧的敌人。

fields.english: Hurls a fiery ball at the nearest enemy, dealing Fire damage and applying 2 stacks of Burning, and plants a bomb that explodes after 2 sec for 50% damage and 2 stacks of Burning to enemies within 6 yards.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人掷出一个火球，造成火焰伤害并施加2层燃烧，同时埋下一颗炸弹，在2秒后爆炸，对6码内的敌人造成50%的伤害并施加2层燃烧。

fields.english: Calls down 3 pillars of fire one after another through the largest group of enemies, each dealing Fire damage and applying 2 stacks of Burning.
fields.translation: 在最大的敌群中接连降下3根火柱，每根造成火焰伤害并施加2层燃烧。

fields.english: Calls down a pillar of fire on the largest group of enemies, dealing Fire damage and applying 2 stacks of Burning. The ground burns for 6 sec, adding 1 stack of Burning every sec to enemies within 8 yards.
fields.translation: 在最大的敌群上空召唤一根火柱，造成火焰伤害并施加2层燃烧。地面燃烧6秒，每秒对8码内的敌人施加1层燃烧。

fields.english: A meteor falls on the largest group of enemies, dealing heavy Fire damage and 2 stacks of Burning to enemies within 8 yards. Its crater burns for 4 sec, adding 1 stack of Burning every sec to enemies within 5 yards.
fields.translation: 一颗陨石坠落砸向最大的敌群，对其8码内的敌人造成高额火焰伤害并施加2层燃烧。陨坑燃烧4秒，每秒对5码内的敌人施加1层燃烧。

fields.english: 7 meteors fall on the largest group of enemies, each dealing Fire damage within 3 yards, 10% more per Burning stack on the enemy, up to 30 stacks.
fields.translation: 7颗陨石坠落砸向最大的敌群，每颗对其3码内造成火焰伤害，敌人每层燃烧使伤害提高10%，最多计算30层。

fields.english: A wave of fire blasts all enemies within 10 yards of you, dealing Fire damage, 10% more per Burning stack, up to 30 stacks. Every Burning enemy it hits erupts for 40% damage on up to 3 enemies within 5 yards.
fields.translation: 一道火浪轰击你10码内的所有敌人，造成火焰伤害，每层燃烧使伤害提高10%，最多计算30层。被击中的敌人若身上带有燃烧，会喷发火焰，对其5码内最多3个敌人造成40%的伤害。

fields.english: Blasts the 3 enemies with the most Burning, dealing Fire damage, 10% more per Burning stack, up to 30 stacks. Its first critical strike each cast instantly casts your Pyroblast, or a Pyroblast at the target if you don't have it.
fields.translation: 轰击燃烧层数最多的3个敌人，造成火焰伤害，每层燃烧使伤害提高10%，最多计算30层。此法术每次施放中的首次致命一击会立即施放你的炎爆术；若你没有炎爆术，则改为对目标施放一发炎爆术。

fields.english: Your dash becomes Blink, with 1 additional charge and a 30% shorter cooldown. Each Blink sets off an Arcane Explosion where you leave, dealing Arcane damage to enemies within 10 yards, hits every enemy along your path and makes you immune to damage for 1 sec.
fields.translation: 你的冲刺变为闪现术，充能次数增加1次，冷却时间缩短30%。每次闪现都会在你离开的位置引发一次奥术爆炸，对10码内的敌人造成奥术伤害，命中沿途的所有敌人，并使你免疫伤害1秒。

fields.english: Your dash becomes Blink, with 3 additional charges and a 30% shorter cooldown. Each Blink sets off an Arcane Explosion where you leave, dealing Arcane damage to enemies within 10 yards, and resets the cooldown of Arcane Explosion.
fields.translation: 你的冲刺变为闪现术，充能次数增加3次，冷却时间缩短30%。每次闪现都会在你离开的位置引发一次奥术爆炸，对10码内的敌人造成奥术伤害，并重置奥术爆炸的冷却时间。

fields.english: Blasts all enemies within 10 yards of you with arcane energy, dealing Arcane damage. Also goes off where you land after each Blink. A blast leaves a time bubble for 10 sec: normal enemies inside move 60% slower and all enemies inside take 15% more damage.
fields.translation: 以奥术能量轰击你10码内的所有敌人，造成奥术伤害。每次闪现落地的位置也会引发爆炸。爆炸会留下一个时间泡，持续10秒：泡内的普通敌人移动速度降低60%，泡内所有敌人受到的伤害提高15%。

fields.english: Blasts all enemies within 10 yards of you with arcane energy, dealing Arcane damage. Also goes off where you land after each Blink. Each blast instantly casts one of your other spells, at most once every 0.5 sec.
fields.translation: 以奥术能量轰击你10码内的所有敌人，造成奥术伤害。每次闪现落地的位置也会引发爆炸。每次爆炸都会立即施放你的一个其他法术，每0.5秒至多触发一次。

fields.english: Launches 5 Arcane Missiles at the nearest enemy over 1 sec, each dealing Arcane damage. With Blink, missiles pile up while you move instead, up to 40, and your next Blink fires them all at the nearest enemies.
fields.translation: 在1秒内向最近的敌人发射5枚奥术飞弹，每枚造成奥术伤害。搭配闪现术时，飞弹改为在你移动时积攒，最多40枚，你下一次闪现术会将它们全部射向最近的敌人。

fields.english: Launches 5 Arcane Missiles at the nearest enemy over 1 sec, each dealing Arcane damage. After each Blink, it fires all 5 at once at the nearest enemies and your spells deal 30% more damage for 4 sec.
fields.translation: 在1秒内向最近的敌人发射5枚奥术飞弹，每枚造成奥术伤害。每次闪现术后，会一次性向最近的敌人发射全部5枚，并使你的法术伤害提高30%，持续4秒。

fields.english: Summons a three-headed hydra that spits Frost, Fire and Arcane bolts at enemies within 30 yards. Each head picks a different enemy. Its frost head applies Chill and its fire head Burning. It follows you when you move far away.
fields.translation: 召唤一条三头九头蛇，向30码内的敌人喷吐冰霜、火焰和奥术箭。每个头会选择不同的敌人。它的冰霜头施加冰寒，火焰头施加燃烧。你走远时它会跟随你。

fields.english: Summons an elemental that changes school every 5 sec: Water applies Chill, Fire applies Burning, then Arcane.
fields.translation: 召唤一个元素，每5秒转换一次派系：水元素施加冰寒，火元素施加燃烧，然后是奥术。

fields.english: Smites the 2 nearest enemies for Holy damage. Each Smite reduces the cooldown of Holy Word: Chastise by 1 sec.
fields.translation: 惩击最近的2个敌人，造成神圣伤害。每次惩击都会使圣言术：惩的冷却时间缩短1秒。

fields.english: Heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec. At full health, it smites the nearest enemy within 30 yards for Holy damage instead.
fields.translation: 每秒为你恢复1%最大生命值。生命值全满时，改为惩击30码内最近的敌人，造成神圣伤害。

fields.english: A ring of light hits every enemy within 12 yards of you for Holy damage and heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 2%.
fields.translation: 一道光环击中你12码内的所有敌人，造成神圣伤害，并每命中一个敌人为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，最多2%。

fields.english: The Light strikes the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, for heavy Holy damage. Each Smite or Halo reduces its cooldown by 1 sec.
fields.translation: 圣光打击附近最强的敌人，优先选择精英，造成高额神圣伤害。每次惩击或圣光圆环都会使此法术的冷却时间缩短1秒。

fields.english: Shields you for 10% of your maximum health; each cast tops it back up instead of stacking. You move 10% faster while shielded.
fields.translation: 为你施加护盾，可吸收相当于10%最大生命值的伤害；每次施法会将护盾补满而非叠加。持有护盾期间你的移动速度提高10%。

fields.english: Fires 3 holy bolts at the enemies that struck you last, or the nearest enemies, each dealing Holy damage and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health. Healing past full health becomes Shield.
fields.translation: 向最近攻击过你的敌人发射3枚神圣箭，若没有则射向最近的敌人，每枚造成神圣伤害并为你恢复0.5%最大生命值。溢出满生命值的治疗会转化为护盾。

fields.english: Normal enemies within 8 yards flee in fear for 2 sec and take Shadow damage every sec. Elites, mini-bosses and bosses do not flee.
fields.translation: 你8码内的普通敌人因恐惧而逃跑，持续2秒，并每秒受到暗影伤害。精英、小首领和首领不会逃跑。

fields.english: Binds the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, for 2 sec. It takes Holy damage when bound and every sec while bound. Bosses and mini-bosses cannot be bound but still take the first hit.
fields.translation: 束缚附近最强的敌人，优先选择精英，持续2秒。敌人被束缚时以及束缚期间每秒受到神圣伤害。首领和小首领无法被束缚，但仍会受到初次打击。

fields.english: Afflicts the 3 enemies farthest from you within 35 yards with 6 stacks of Decay.
fields.translation: 使35码内离你最远的3个敌人染上6层腐朽。

fields.english: Flays the nearest enemy within 20 yards, dealing Shadow damage, applying 1 stack of Decay and slowing it by 30%. Keeps flaying it until it dies or leaves range.
fields.translation: 鞭笞20码内最近的敌人，造成暗影伤害，施加1层腐朽并使其减速30%。持续鞭笞该敌人直至其死亡或离开范围。

fields.english: Blasts the enemy with the most Decay for Shadow damage. Every enemy within 8 yards of it gains as many Decay stacks as it has, up to 10.
fields.translation: 轰击腐朽层数最多的敌人，造成暗影伤害。其8码内的所有敌人都会获得与其相同的腐朽层数，最多10层。

fields.english: Summons a Shadowfiend whose attacks apply Decay and heal you for 0.5% of your maximum health.
fields.translation: 召唤一只暗影魔，其攻击会施加腐朽，并为你恢复0.5%最大生命值。

fields.english: Smites the nearest enemy with holy fire, dealing Holy damage and applying 3 stacks of Burning. Each Smite reduces the cooldown of Holy Word: Chastise by 1 sec.
fields.translation: 以圣火惩击最近的敌人，造成神圣伤害并施加3层燃烧。每次惩击都会使圣言术：惩的冷却时间缩短1秒。

fields.english: Smites the nearest enemy for Holy damage. Every 4th Smite also hits enemies within 6 yards of the target and stuns normal enemies for 1 sec. Each Smite reduces the cooldown of Holy Word: Chastise by 1 sec.
fields.translation: 惩击最近的敌人，造成神圣伤害。每第4次惩击还会命中目标6码内的敌人，并使普通敌人昏迷1秒。每次惩击都会使圣言术：惩的冷却时间缩短1秒。

fields.english: Heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec. At full health, it smites the nearest enemy within 30 yards for Holy damage instead. Any healing past full health also smites, at most twice a sec.
fields.translation: 每秒为你恢复1%最大生命值。生命值全满时，改为惩击30码内最近的敌人，造成神圣伤害。任何溢出满生命值的治疗也会触发惩击，每秒至多两次。

fields.english: Heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec. At full health, it smites the nearest enemy within 30 yards for Holy damage instead, jumping to 2 additional nearby enemies.
fields.translation: 每秒为你恢复1%最大生命值。生命值全满时，改为惩击30码内最近的敌人，造成神圣伤害，并跳向附近的2个额外敌人。

fields.english: A ring of light goes off 3 times over 2 sec, each hitting every enemy within 12 yards of you for Holy damage and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 2%.
fields.translation: 在2秒内接连爆发3次光环，每次击中你12码内的所有敌人，造成神圣伤害，并每命中一个敌人为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，最多2%。

fields.english: A ring of light hits every enemy within 12 yards of you for Holy damage, up to 100% more the farther they are, and heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 2%.
fields.translation: 一道光环击中你12码内的所有敌人，造成神圣伤害，距离越远伤害越高，最多提高100%，并每命中一个敌人为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，最多2%。

fields.english: The Light strikes the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, for heavy Holy damage, hits enemies within 8 yards of it for half and heals you for 5% of your maximum health. Each Smite or Halo reduces its cooldown by 1 sec.
fields.translation: 圣光打击附近最强的敌人，优先选择精英，造成高额神圣伤害，对其8码内的敌人造成一半伤害，并为你恢复5%最大生命值。每次惩击或圣光圆环都会使此法术的冷却时间缩短1秒。

fields.english: The Light strikes the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, for heavy Holy damage and resets the cooldowns of Smite and Halo. Each Smite or Halo reduces its cooldown by 1 sec.
fields.translation: 圣光打击附近最强的敌人，优先选择精英，造成高额神圣伤害，并重置惩击和圣光圆环的冷却时间。每次惩击或圣光圆环都会使此法术的冷却时间缩短1秒。

fields.english: Shields you for 10% of your maximum health; each cast tops it back up instead of stacking. You move 10% faster while shielded, and damage it absorbs is dealt back to the attacker as Holy damage.
fields.translation: 为你施加护盾，可吸收相当于10%最大生命值的伤害；每次施法会将护盾补满而非叠加。持有护盾期间你的移动速度提高10%，且护盾吸收的伤害会以神圣伤害的形式返还给攻击者。

fields.english: Shields you for 10% of your maximum health and raises a dome at your feet for 5 sec; you take 25% less damage inside. Each cast tops the Shield back up instead of stacking. You move 10% faster while shielded.
fields.translation: 为你施加护盾，可吸收相当于10%最大生命值的伤害，并在你脚下撑起一道防护罩，持续5秒；罩内你受到的伤害降低25%。每次施法会将护盾补满而非叠加。持有护盾期间你的移动速度提高10%。

fields.english: Fires 3 holy bolts at the enemies that struck you last, or 5 while you have a Shield, each dealing Holy damage and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health. Healing past full health becomes Shield.
fields.translation: 向最近攻击过你的敌人发射3枚神圣箭，持有护盾时改为5枚，每枚造成神圣伤害并为你恢复0.5%最大生命值。溢出满生命值的治疗会转化为护盾。

fields.english: Fires 3 holy bolts at the enemies that struck you last, each dealing Holy damage, hitting enemies within 4 yards for half and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health. Healing past full health becomes Shield.
fields.translation: 向最近攻击过你的敌人发射3枚神圣箭，每枚造成神圣伤害，命中其4码内的敌人造成一半伤害，并为你恢复0.5%最大生命值。溢出满生命值的治疗会转化为护盾。

fields.english: Normal enemies within 8 yards flee in fear for 2 sec and take Shadow damage every sec, plus 20% more damage from everything. Elites, mini-bosses and bosses do not flee.
fields.translation: 你8码内的普通敌人因恐惧而逃跑，持续2秒，每秒受到暗影伤害，且受到的所有伤害提高20%。精英、小首领和首领不会逃跑。

fields.english: Normal enemies within 8 yards flee in fear for 2 sec, gain 3 stacks of Decay and take Shadow damage every sec. Elites, mini-bosses and bosses do not flee.
fields.translation: 你8码内的普通敌人因恐惧而逃跑，持续2秒，获得3层腐朽并每秒受到暗影伤害。精英、小首领和首领不会逃跑。

fields.english: Binds the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, for 2 sec. It takes Holy damage when bound and every sec while bound, and 30% more damage from everything. Bosses and mini-bosses cannot be bound but still take the first hit.
fields.translation: 束缚附近最强的敌人，优先选择精英，持续2秒。敌人被束缚时以及束缚期间每秒受到神圣伤害，且受到的所有伤害提高30%。首领和小首领无法被束缚，但仍会受到初次打击。

fields.english: Binds the 3 strongest enemies nearby, elites first, for 2 sec. They take Holy damage when bound and every sec while bound. Bosses and mini-bosses cannot be bound but still take the first hit.
fields.translation: 束缚附近最强的3个敌人，优先选择精英，持续2秒。敌人被束缚时以及束缚期间每秒受到神圣伤害。首领和小首领无法被束缚，但仍会受到初次打击。

fields.english: Afflicts the 3 enemies farthest from you within 35 yards with 6 stacks of Decay. Your Decay heals you for 2% of its damage, up to 1% of your maximum health a sec.
fields.translation: 使35码内离你最远的3个敌人染上6层腐朽。你的腐朽所造成伤害的2%会为你恢复生命值，每秒最多恢复1%最大生命值。

fields.english: Afflicts the 3 enemies farthest from you within 35 yards with 6 stacks of Decay and 1 stack of Shadow Vulnerability.
fields.translation: 使35码内离你最远的3个敌人染上6层腐朽和1层暗影易伤。

fields.english: Flays the nearest enemy, dealing Shadow damage to it and half to enemies within 6 yards, applying 1 stack of Decay and slowing it by 30%.
fields.translation: 鞭笞最近的敌人，对其造成暗影伤害，对其6码内的敌人造成一半伤害，施加1层腐朽并使其减速30%。

fields.english: Flays the nearest enemy, dealing Shadow damage, applying 1 stack of Decay and slowing it by 30%. When it dies, its Decay moves to your next target.
fields.translation: 鞭笞最近的敌人，造成暗影伤害，施加1层腐朽并使其减速30%。当它死亡时，其腐朽效果会转移到你的下一个目标身上。

fields.english: Blasts the enemy with the most Decay for Shadow damage. Every enemy within 8 yards of it gains as many Decay stacks as it has, up to 10, then its own Decay deals all its remaining damage at once.
fields.translation: 轰击腐朽层数最多的敌人，造成暗影伤害。其8码内的所有敌人都会获得与其相同的腐朽层数，最多10层，随后其自身的腐朽会立即造成所有剩余伤害。

fields.english: Blasts the enemy with the most Decay for Shadow damage. Every enemy within 8 yards of it takes half and gains as many Decay stacks as it has, up to 10.
fields.translation: 轰击腐朽层数最多的敌人，造成暗影伤害。其8码内的所有敌人受到一半伤害，并获得与其相同的腐朽层数，最多10层。

fields.english: Summons a Shadowfiend whose attacks hit enemies within 5 yards of its target, apply Decay and heal you for 0.5% of your maximum health.
fields.translation: 召唤一只暗影魔，其攻击会命中目标5码内的敌人，施加腐朽，并为你恢复0.5%最大生命值。

fields.english: Summons a Shadowfiend whose attacks apply Decay and heal you for 0.5% of your maximum health. Every 6 sec it roots normal enemies within 6 yards for 2 sec.
fields.translation: 召唤一只暗影魔，其攻击会施加腐朽，并为你恢复0.5%最大生命值。它会每隔6秒定身6码内的普通敌人2秒。

fields.english: Stabs the nearest enemy for damage.
fields.translation: 刺击最近的敌人，造成伤害。

fields.english: Your single-target hits also strike 4 more enemies within 8 yards at 50% damage for 8 sec. The extra hits carry your poisons and openers.
fields.translation: 在8秒内，你的单体攻击还会以50%的伤害打击8码内的4个额外敌人。额外攻击会附带你的毒药和起手技。

fields.english: Guts the nearest enemy for heavy damage, with double critical strike chance.
fields.translation: 剖开最近的敌人，造成高额伤害，致命一击几率翻倍。

fields.english: Strikes 8 times over 2 sec, each strike hitting a random enemy within 10 yards for damage and carrying your poisons and openers.
fields.translation: 在2秒内连续攻击8次，每次攻击随机命中10码内的一个敌人，造成伤害并附带你的药膏和起手技。

fields.english: Stabs the nearest enemy with both daggers for damage, each stab applying 1 stack of Poison. Deals 30% more to Poisoned enemies.
fields.translation: 双持匕首刺击最近的敌人，造成伤害，每次刺击施加1层中毒。对已中毒的敌人造成的伤害提高30%。

fields.english: Your other abilities apply 1 stack of Poison with every hit.
fields.translation: 你的其他技能每次命中都会施加1层中毒。

fields.english: Throws knives in every direction, striking all enemies within 10 yards for damage and applying 2 stacks of Poison. Every knife carries your poisons and openers.
fields.translation: 向四面八方掷出飞刀，打击10码内的所有敌人，造成伤害并施加2层中毒。每把飞刀都会附带你的药膏和起手技。

fields.english: Strikes the enemy with the most Poison for Nature damage, and your hits apply 2 more stacks of Poison for 5 sec.
fields.translation: 打击中毒层数最多的敌人，造成自然伤害，并使你的攻击在5秒内额外施加2层中毒。

fields.english: Throws shurikens at the 3 nearest enemies within 20 yards, ones you have not hit yet first, dealing damage.
fields.translation: 向20码内最近的3个敌人投掷手里剑，优先攻击你尚未命中过的敌人，造成伤害。

fields.english: Your first hit on each enemy with your other abilities is followed by an Ambush for heavy damage, with double critical strike chance.
fields.translation: 你的其他技能对每个敌人的首次命中之后，会发动一次伏击，造成高额伤害，致命一击几率翻倍。

fields.english: Your hits deal 30% more damage for 4 sec and can set off Ambush again, once a sec per enemy.
fields.translation: 在4秒内你的攻击造成的伤害提高30%，且可再次触发伏击，每个敌人每秒一次。

fields.english: You dodge 50% more attacks for 5 sec.
fields.translation: 在5秒内你的闪避几率提高50%。

fields.english: Stabs the nearest enemy for damage, followed by an off-hand stab at a different enemy within 8 yards.
fields.translation: 刺击最近的敌人，造成伤害，随后以副手刺击8码内的另一个敌人。

fields.english: Stabs the nearest enemy for damage. When a stab kills its target, you instantly stab the next nearest enemy, up to 3 times in a row.
fields.translation: 刺击最近的敌人，造成伤害。刺击击杀目标时，你会立即刺击下一个最近的敌人，最多连续3次。

fields.english: Your single-target hits always strike 2 more enemies within 8 yards at 50% damage. The extra hits carry your poisons and openers.
fields.translation: 你的单体攻击始终会以50%的伤害额外打击8码内的2个敌人。额外攻击会附带你的药膏和起手技。

fields.english: Your single-target hits also strike 4 more enemies within 8 yards at 50% damage as Shadow damage for 8 sec. Extra hits can set off Ambush again, once a sec per enemy.
fields.translation: 在8秒内，你的单体攻击还会打击8码内的4个额外敌人，造成50%的暗影伤害。额外攻击可再次触发伏击，每个敌人每秒一次。

fields.english: Guts the 5 nearest enemies for heavy damage, with double critical strike chance.
fields.translation: 剖开最近的5个敌人，造成高额伤害，致命一击几率翻倍。

fields.english: Throws a blade at the strongest enemy within 30 yards, elites first, for heavy damage with double critical strike chance. Normal enemies hit are slowed by 50% for 3 sec.
fields.translation: 向30码内最强的敌人掷出一把利刃，优先选择精英，造成高额伤害，致命一击几率翻倍。被命中的普通敌人减速50%，持续3秒。

fields.english: Strikes 8 times over 2 sec, each strike hitting a random enemy within 10 yards for damage. Each kill adds 2 strikes, up to 20 more.
fields.translation: 在2秒内连续攻击8次，每次攻击随机命中10码内的一个敌人，造成伤害。每击杀一个敌人增加2次攻击，最多增加20次。

fields.english: Strikes 8 times over 2 sec, each strike hitting a random enemy within 10 yards for damage. The last strike also fires Eviscerate and Envenom, if you hold them, without triggering their cooldowns.
fields.translation: 在2秒内连续攻击8次，每次攻击随机命中10码内的一个敌人，造成伤害。最后一击还会触发你的剔骨和毒伤（若你拥有它们），且不会触发它们的冷却时间。

fields.english: Stabs the nearest enemy with both daggers for damage, each stab applying 1 stack of Poison and 2 stacks of Nature Vulnerability. Deals 30% more to Poisoned enemies.
fields.translation: 双持匕首刺击最近的敌人，造成伤害，每次刺击施加1层中毒和2层自然易伤。对已中毒的敌人造成的伤害提高30%。

fields.english: Stabs the nearest enemy with both daggers for damage, 3 times below 35% health, each stab applying 1 stack of Poison. Deals 30% more to Poisoned enemies.
fields.translation: 双持匕首刺击最近的敌人，造成伤害，目标生命值低于35%时改为刺击3次，每次刺击施加1层中毒。对已中毒的敌人造成的伤害提高30%。

fields.english: Your other abilities apply 1 stack of Poison with every hit and slow normal enemies by 30%. Poisoned enemies take 15% more damage from you.
fields.translation: 你的其他技能每次命中都会施加1层中毒，并使普通敌人减速30%。已中毒的敌人受到你造成的伤害提高15%。

fields.english: Your other abilities apply 1 stack of Poison with every hit and deal 30% extra as Nature damage.
fields.translation: 你的其他技能每次命中都会施加1层中毒，并额外造成30%的自然伤害。

fields.english: Throws knives in every direction, striking all enemies within 10 yards for damage and applying 2 stacks of Poison. Leaves caltrops for 4 sec that slow enemies and add 1 stack of Poison every sec.
fields.translation: 向四面八方掷出飞刀，打击10码内的所有敌人，造成伤害并施加2层中毒。同时在地面留下铁蒺藜，持续4秒，使敌人减速并每秒施加1层中毒。

fields.english: Throws knives in every direction, striking all enemies within 10 yards for damage and applying 2 stacks of Poison. Also throws when Eviscerate or Envenom fires.
fields.translation: 向四面八方掷出飞刀，打击10码内的所有敌人，造成伤害并施加2层中毒。剔骨或毒伤触发时也会掷出飞刀。

fields.english: Strikes the enemy with the most Poison and every Poisoned enemy within 8 yards of it for Nature damage, and your hits apply 2 more stacks of Poison for 5 sec.
fields.translation: 打击中毒层数最多的敌人及其8码内所有中毒的敌人，造成自然伤害，并使你的攻击在5秒内额外施加2层中毒。

fields.english: Strikes the enemy with the most Poison for Nature damage. It and every Poisoned enemy within 10 yards take the damage their Poison would deal over the next 4 sec, keeping their stacks. Your hits apply 2 more stacks of Poison for 5 sec.
fields.translation: 打击中毒层数最多的敌人，造成自然伤害。该敌人及其10码内所有中毒的敌人会立即承受其中毒效果在接下来4秒内将造成的伤害，并保留层数。你的攻击在5秒内额外施加2层中毒。

fields.english: Throws shurikens at the 2 nearest enemies within 20 yards, ones you have not hit yet first, dealing damage. Each one jumps to 2 more nearby enemies.
fields.translation: 向20码内最近的2个敌人投掷手里剑，优先攻击你尚未命中过的敌人，造成伤害。每枚手里剑会弹向2个附近的其他敌人。

fields.english: Throws shurikens at the 2 nearest enemies within 20 yards, ones you have not hit yet first, dealing damage. A shadow stays where each hits and bursts 1.5 sec later for Shadow damage within 5 yards.
fields.translation: 向20码内最近的2个敌人投掷手里剑，优先攻击你尚未命中过的敌人，造成伤害。每枚命中处会留下一道暗影，在1.5秒后爆发，对5码内的敌人造成暗影伤害。

fields.english: Your first hit on each enemy with your other abilities is followed by an Ambush for heavy damage, with double critical strike chance. Ambush stuns normal enemies for 1 sec.
fields.translation: 你的其他技能对每个敌人的首次命中之后，会发动一次伏击，造成高额伤害，致命一击几率翻倍。伏击会使普通敌人昏迷1秒。

fields.english: Your first hit on each enemy with your other abilities is followed by an Ambush for heavy damage, with double critical strike chance. Ambushed enemies take 20% more damage from you for 6 sec.
fields.translation: 你的其他技能对每个敌人的首次命中之后，会发动一次伏击，造成高额伤害，致命一击几率翻倍。被伏击的敌人在6秒内受到你造成的伤害提高20%。

fields.english: Your hits deal 30% more damage for 4 sec and can set off Ambush again, once a sec per enemy. Starts with a vanish: normal enemies within 10 yards lose you and stand dazed for 2 sec.
fields.translation: 在4秒内你的攻击造成的伤害提高30%，且可再次触发伏击，每个敌人每秒一次。发动时先消失一次：10码内的普通敌人会丢失你的踪影并眩晕2秒。

fields.english: Your hits deal 30% more damage for 4 sec and can set off Ambush again, once a sec per enemy. Starts with a shadow strike on the 5 strongest enemies within 14 yards for damage.
fields.translation: 4秒内你的攻击造成的伤害提高30%，且可再次触发伏击，每个敌人每秒一次。发动时先以暗影打击14码内最强的5个敌人，造成伤害。

fields.english: You dodge 50% more attacks for 5 sec, and every dodge strikes the attacker back for damage.
fields.translation: 在5秒内你的闪避几率提高50%，且每次闪避都会反击攻击者，造成伤害。

fields.english: You dodge 50% more attacks for 5 sec, and enemy attacks miss you half the time while you stand in the smoke at your feet.
fields.translation: 在5秒内你的闪避几率提高50%，且站在你脚下烟雾中时，敌人的攻击有一半几率未命中你。

fields.english: Hurls lightning at the nearest enemy, bouncing to 1 more, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static to each.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人掷出闪电，并弹向1个额外敌人，对每个敌人造成自然伤害并施加1层静电。

fields.english: Hurls lightning at the nearest enemy, jumping to 4 more, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static to each.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人掷出闪电，并跳向4个额外敌人，对每个敌人造成自然伤害并施加1层静电。

fields.english: Shocks the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, dealing Fire damage and applying 6 stacks of Burning.
fields.translation: 震击附近最强的敌人，优先选择精英，造成火焰伤害并施加6层燃烧。

fields.english: Shocks the enemy with the most Static for Nature damage, 50% more per Static stack. Consumes the stacks in a discharge that also hits up to 3 nearby enemies.
fields.translation: 震击静电层数最多的敌人，造成自然伤害，每层静电使伤害提高50%。消耗这些层数进行放电，还会命中最多3个附近敌人。

fields.english: Swings at the nearest enemy for damage. Every 3rd swing calls Windfury: 2 extra swings that also hit enemies within 4 yards of the target.
fields.translation: 挥击最近的敌人，造成伤害。每第3次挥击会唤起风怒：额外挥击2次，同时命中目标4码内的敌人。

fields.english: Strikes the nearest enemy within 12 yards twice, with weapon and lightning, for damage, applying 2 stacks of Static and 2 stacks of Nature Vulnerability.
fields.translation: 以武器和闪电双重打击12码内最近的敌人，造成伤害，施加2层静电和2层自然易伤。

fields.english: Every 5th melee hit hurls a free Lightning Bolt at the nearest enemy, or a Chain Lightning if you have it, dealing Nature damage. Melee hits are Windfury Weapon swings, Stormstrike and Feral Spirit bites.
fields.translation: 每5次近战命中会免费向最近的敌人掷出一道闪电箭，若你拥有闪电链则改为闪电链，造成自然伤害。近战命中包括风怒武器挥击、风暴打击和野性狼魂的撕咬。

fields.english: Summons 2 spirit wolves whose bites apply Static.
fields.translation: 召唤2头灵魂之狼，它们的撕咬会施加静电。

fields.english: Plants a Searing Totem at your feet that hurls fire at 2 enemies within 20 yards, applying Burning. It is replanted when you move away.
fields.translation: 在你脚下插入一根灼热图腾，向20码内的2个敌人掷出火焰，施加燃烧。你远离时图腾会重新插到你脚下。

fields.english: Plants a Magma Totem at your feet that pulses fire every 2 sec, dealing Fire damage and 1 stack of Burning to enemies within 8 yards.
fields.translation: 在你脚下插入一根熔岩图腾，每2秒喷发一次火焰，对8码内的敌人造成火焰伤害并施加1层燃烧。

fields.english: Plants a Healing Stream Totem at your feet that heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec while you stay within 15 yards.
fields.translation: 在你脚下插入一根治疗之泉图腾，只要你停留在15码内，它就会每秒为你恢复1%最大生命值。

fields.english: Surrounds you with up to 3 lightning charges. An enemy that strikes you is zapped for Nature damage and 1 stack of Static. One charge returns every 3 sec.
fields.translation: 以最多3层闪电充能环绕你。攻击你的敌人会被电击，受到自然伤害并叠加1层静电。每3秒恢复一层充能。

fields.english: Hurls lightning at the nearest enemy, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static. A bolt that sets off a Static discharge also hurls a Chain Lightning from that enemy.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人掷出闪电，造成自然伤害并施加1层静电。引发静电放电的闪电还会从该敌人身上再掷出一道闪电链。

fields.english: Hurls lava at the enemy with the most Burning, dealing Fire damage. Always critically strikes Burning enemies.
fields.translation: 向燃烧层数最多的敌人掷出熔岩，造成火焰伤害。必定对燃烧中的敌人造成致命一击。

fields.english: Hurls lightning at the nearest enemy that jumps up to 10 times, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static to each. Each jump deals 15% less.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人掷出闪电，闪电最多跳跃10次，对每个敌人造成自然伤害并施加1层静电。每次跳跃造成的伤害降低15%。

fields.english: Hurls Chain Lightning at the 2 nearest enemies, each jumping to 4 more, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static to each.
fields.translation: 向最近的2个敌人各掷出一道闪电链，每道跳向4个额外敌人，对每个敌人造成自然伤害并施加1层静电。

fields.english: Shocks the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, dealing Frost damage and applying 6 stacks of Chill.
fields.translation: 震击附近最强的敌人，优先选择精英，造成冰霜伤害并施加6层冰寒。

fields.english: Shocks the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, dealing Fire damage and applying 6 stacks of Burning. Burning enemies that die fire a Lightning Bolt at once.
fields.translation: 震击附近最强的敌人，优先选择精英，造成火焰伤害并施加6层燃烧。燃烧中的敌人死亡时会立即射出一道闪电箭。

fields.english: Shocks the enemy with the most Static for Nature damage, 50% more per Static stack. Consumes the stacks in a discharge that also hits up to 3 nearby enemies, and the ground shakes for 4 sec, Dazing enemies inside and dealing Nature damage every sec.
fields.translation: 震击静电层数最多的敌人，造成自然伤害，每层静电使伤害提高50%。消耗这些层数进行放电，还会命中最多3个附近敌人，同时大地震颤4秒，使其中的敌人眩晕并每秒受到自然伤害。

fields.english: Shocks the enemy with the most Static for Nature damage, 50% more per Static stack. Consumes the stacks in a discharge that also hits up to 3 nearby enemies. Every Static discharge within 10 yards of you also hits enemies within 6 yards of it.
fields.translation: 震击静电层数最多的敌人，造成自然伤害，每层静电使伤害提高50%。消耗这些层数进行放电，还会命中最多3个附近敌人。你10码内的每次静电放电还会命中其6码内的敌人。

fields.english: Swings at the nearest enemy for damage, adding Fire damage and 1 stack of Burning. Every 3rd swing calls Windfury: 2 extra swings that also hit enemies within 4 yards and apply 3 stacks of Burning.
fields.translation: 挥击最近的敌人，造成伤害，附加火焰伤害并施加1层燃烧。每第3次挥击会唤起风怒：额外挥击2次，同时命中4码内的敌人并施加3层燃烧。

fields.english: Swings at the nearest enemy for damage. Every 3rd swing calls Windfury: 2 extra swings that also hit enemies within 4 yards. Every 15 sec, every swing calls Windfury for 4 sec.
fields.translation: 挥击最近的敌人，造成伤害。每第3次挥击会唤起风怒：额外挥击2次，同时命中4码内的敌人。每隔15秒，所有挥击都会唤起风怒，持续4秒。

fields.english: Strikes the nearest enemy within 12 yards twice, with weapon and lava, for damage, applying 2 stacks of Static, 2 of Nature Vulnerability and 2 of Burning. The lava deals 50% more to Burning enemies.
fields.translation: 以武器和熔岩两次打击12码内最近的敌人，造成伤害，施加2层静电、2层自然易伤和2层燃烧。熔岩对燃烧中的敌人造成的伤害提高50%。

fields.english: Strikes the nearest enemy within 12 yards twice, with weapon and lightning, for damage, applying 2 stacks of Static and 2 stacks of Nature Vulnerability. The lightning also hits enemies within 8 yards of you with 1 stack of Static.
fields.translation: 以武器和闪电双重打击12码内最近的敌人，造成伤害，施加2层静电和2层自然易伤。闪电还会命中你8码内的敌人，施加1层静电。

fields.english: Every 5th melee hit hurls a free Lightning Bolt at the 3 nearest enemies, or a Chain Lightning if you have it, dealing Nature damage.
fields.translation: 每第5次近战命中会免费向最近的3个敌人掷出闪电箭，若你拥有闪电链则改为闪电链，造成自然伤害。

fields.english: Every 5th melee hit hurls a free Lightning Bolt at the nearest enemy, or a Chain Lightning if you have it, dealing Nature damage and 5 stacks of Static, so it discharges at once.
fields.translation: 每第5次近战命中会免费向最近的敌人掷出闪电箭，若你拥有闪电链则改为闪电链，造成自然伤害并施加5层静电，使其立即放电。

fields.english: Summons 2 spirit wolves in fire, frost and lightning forms whose bites apply Burning, Chill or Static.
fields.translation: 召唤2头火焰、冰霜和闪电形态的灵魂之狼，它们的撕咬会施加燃烧、冰寒或静电。

fields.english: Summons 2 spirit wolves whose bites apply Static. Each Windfury calls an extra wolf for 6 sec.
fields.translation: 召唤2头灵魂之狼，它们的撕咬会施加静电。每次唤起风怒都会召唤一头额外的狼，持续6秒。

fields.english: Plants a Searing Totem at your feet that hurls fire at an enemy within 20 yards, applying Burning. Every 4 sec it bursts, dealing Fire damage and 3 stacks of Burning to enemies within 8 yards, and is replanted at your feet.
fields.translation: 在你脚下插入一根灼热图腾，向20码内的一个敌人掷出火焰，施加燃烧。每4秒爆发一次，对8码内的敌人造成火焰伤害并施加3层燃烧，然后重新插到你脚下。

fields.english: Plants a Searing Totem at your feet that hurls fire at 2 enemies within 20 yards, applying Burning. Enemies within 15 yards of it take 15% more Fire damage.
fields.translation: 在你脚下插入一根灼热图腾，向20码内的2个敌人掷出火焰，施加燃烧。图腾15码内的敌人受到的火焰伤害提高15%。

fields.english: Plants a Magma Totem at your feet that pulses fire every 2 sec, dealing Fire damage and 1 stack of Burning to enemies within 8 yards. Each pulse also hurls 2 globs of magma at enemies within 12 yards.
fields.translation: 在你脚下插入一根熔岩图腾，每2秒喷发一次火焰，对8码内的敌人造成火焰伤害并施加1层燃烧。每次喷发还会向12码内的敌人掷出2团岩浆。

fields.english: Plants a Magma Totem at your feet that pulses fire every 2 sec, dealing Fire damage and 1 stack of Burning to enemies within 8 yards and Dazing them.
fields.translation: 在你脚下插入一根熔岩图腾，每2秒喷发一次火焰，对8码内的敌人造成火焰伤害并施加1层燃烧，同时使其眩晕。

fields.english: Summons a Healing Tide Totem that walks with you and heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec.
fields.translation: 召唤一根随你移动的治疗之潮图腾，每秒为你恢复1%最大生命值。

fields.english: Plants a Healing Stream Totem at your feet that heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec while you stay within 15 yards. Every 3 sec it rains on enemies within 10 yards for Nature damage.
fields.translation: 在你脚下插入一根治疗之泉图腾，只要你停留在15码内，它就会每秒为你恢复1%最大生命值。每3秒还会降雨，对10码内的敌人造成自然伤害。

fields.english: Surrounds you with up to 3 lightning charges. An enemy that strikes you is zapped for Nature damage and 1 stack of Static, and you gain a Shield of 1% of your maximum health, up to 10%. One charge returns every 3 sec.
fields.translation: 以最多3层闪电充能环绕你。攻击你的敌人会被电击，受到自然伤害并叠加1层静电，同时你获得相当于最大生命值1%的护盾，最多叠加至10%。每3秒恢复一层充能。

fields.english: Surrounds you with up to 3 lightning charges. When an enemy strikes you or your melee hits land, a charge zaps the enemy and enemies within 4 yards for Nature damage and 1 stack of Static. One charge returns every 3 sec.
fields.translation: 以最多3层闪电充能环绕你。当敌人攻击你或你的近战攻击命中时，一层充能会电击该敌人及其4码内的敌人，造成自然伤害并施加1层静电。每3秒恢复一层充能。

fields.english: Strikes the nearest enemy for heavy damage and 30% of it to enemies within 5 yards of the target.
fields.translation: 打击最近的敌人，造成高额伤害，并对目标5码内的敌人造成30%的伤害。

fields.english: Slams the 3 strongest enemies within 20 yards with a hammer of light for Holy damage, with double critical strike chance. Releases your Seals: Righteousness adds 50% damage, Command hits enemies within 5 yards of each target for half, Light heals you for 1% of your maximum health per enemy hit.
fields.translation: 以圣光之锤猛击20码内最强的3个敌人，造成神圣伤害，致命一击几率翻倍。同时释放你的圣印：正义圣印额外造成50%伤害，命令圣印对每个目标5码内的敌人造成一半伤害，光明圣印每命中一个敌人为你恢复1%最大生命值。

fields.english: Every 3rd strike from your other Paladin spells releases a burst of light, dealing Holy damage to the target and every enemy within 5 yards of it.
fields.translation: 你的其他圣骑士法术每第3次打击会释放一次圣光爆发，对目标及其5码内的所有敌人造成神圣伤害。

fields.english: Every hit from your other Paladin spells, splash and area hits included, deals 20% extra as Holy damage.
fields.translation: 你的其他圣骑士法术的每次命中，包括溅射和范围命中，都额外造成20%的神圣伤害。

fields.english: Consecrates the ground beneath you for 8 sec, dealing Holy damage every sec to enemies on it. You deal 15% more damage while standing on it.
fields.translation: 将你脚下的地面奉献8秒，每秒对站在其上的敌人造成神圣伤害。你站在其上时造成的伤害提高15%。

fields.english: Strikes the strongest enemy within 30 yards for heavy Holy damage. Undead and Demons take triple damage, elites and bosses double. Critical strikes from your other Paladin spells reset its cooldown, at most once a sec.
fields.translation: 打击30码内最强的敌人，造成高额神圣伤害。亡灵和恶魔受到三倍伤害，精英和首领受到两倍伤害。你的其他圣骑士法术造成致命一击时，会重置此法术的冷却时间，每秒至多一次。

fields.english: Holy light bursts around you, dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 10 yards and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 3%.
fields.translation: 圣光在你周围爆发，对10码内的所有敌人造成神圣伤害，并每命中一个敌人为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，最多3%。

fields.english: Every strike from your other Paladin spells heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health, at most 6 times a sec.
fields.translation: 你的其他圣骑士法术的每次打击都会为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，每秒至多6次。

fields.english: A golden bubble forms around you and blocks the next enemy hit that would take more than 5% of your maximum health.
fields.translation: 一个金色气泡环绕你，抵挡敌人的下一次伤害超过5%最大生命值的攻击。

fields.english: Burns every enemy within 10 yards of you with holy light, dealing Holy damage every sec. Enemies that strike you take double.
fields.translation: 以圣光灼烧你10码内的所有敌人，每秒造成神圣伤害。攻击你的敌人受到双倍伤害。

fields.english: Hurls a hammer at the strongest enemy within 20 yards, dealing Holy damage and stunning it for 2 sec. Bosses are not stunned.
fields.translation: 向20码内最强的敌人掷出一柄战锤，造成神圣伤害并使其昏迷2秒。首领不会被昏迷。

fields.english: Hammers of light fall on 3 random enemies within 25 yards, each dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 5 yards.
fields.translation: 圣光之锤砸落在25码内随机的3个敌人身上，每柄对其5码内的所有敌人造成神圣伤害。

fields.english: Hurls hammers at up to 3 enemies below 20% health within 30 yards. Normal enemies are slain; elites and bosses take heavy Holy damage.
fields.translation: 向30码内最多3个生命值低于20%的敌人掷出战锤。普通敌人被直接击杀；精英和首领受到高额神圣伤害。

fields.english: Strikes the 2 nearest enemies for heavy damage and 50% of it to enemies within 5 yards of each target.
fields.translation: 打击最近的2个敌人，造成高额伤害，并对每个目标5码内的敌人造成50%的伤害。

fields.english: Strikes the nearest enemy for heavy damage and 30% of it to enemies within 5 yards of the target. Each strike has a 15% chance to hurl a Hammer of Wrath for the same damage, slaying normal enemies below 20% health.
fields.translation: 打击最近的敌人，造成高额伤害，并对目标5码内的敌人造成30%的伤害。每次打击有15%几率掷出一柄愤怒之锤，造成等量伤害，击杀生命值低于20%的普通敌人。

fields.english: Slams the 3 strongest enemies within 20 yards with a hammer of light for Holy damage, with double critical strike chance. Heals you for 1% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 5%, and releases your other Seals like Judgement.
fields.translation: 以圣光之锤猛击20码内最强的3个敌人，造成神圣伤害，致命一击几率翻倍。每命中一个敌人为你恢复1%最大生命值，最多5%，并像审判一样释放你的其他圣印。

fields.english: Slams the 3 strongest enemies within 20 yards with a hammer of light for Holy damage, with double critical strike chance. Judged enemies take 20% more damage from you for 6 sec. Releases your Seals like Judgement.
fields.translation: 以圣光之锤猛击20码内最强的3个敌人，造成神圣伤害，致命一击几率翻倍。被审判的敌人在6秒内受到你造成的伤害提高20%。像审判一样释放你的圣印。

fields.english: Every 2nd strike from your other Paladin spells releases a burst of light, dealing Holy damage to the target and every enemy within 5 yards of it.
fields.translation: 你的其他圣骑士法术每第2次打击会释放一次圣光爆发，对目标及其5码内的所有敌人造成神圣伤害。

fields.english: Every 3rd strike from your other Paladin spells releases a burst of light, dealing Holy damage to the target and every enemy within 5 yards of it and stunning normal and elite enemies for 1 sec.
fields.translation: 你的其他圣骑士法术每第3次打击会释放一次圣光爆发，对目标及其5码内的所有敌人造成神圣伤害，并使普通敌人和精英昏迷1秒。

fields.english: Every hit from your other Paladin spells, splash and area hits included, deals 40% extra as Holy damage.
fields.translation: 你的其他圣骑士法术的每次命中，包括溅射和范围命中，都额外造成40%的神圣伤害。

fields.english: Every hit from your other Paladin spells, splash and area hits included, deals 20% extra as Holy damage, 20% more for each hit on the same enemy, up to 5 times.
fields.translation: 你的其他圣骑士法术的每次命中，包括溅射和范围命中，都额外造成20%的神圣伤害，对同一敌人的每次命中使该伤害提高20%，最多计算5次。

fields.english: Consecrates the ground beneath you for 12 sec, dealing Holy damage every sec to enemies on it, up to 3 grounds at once. You deal 25% more damage while standing on it.
fields.translation: 将你脚下的地面奉献12秒，每秒对站在其上的敌人造成神圣伤害，最多同时存在3块奉献之地。你站在其上时造成的伤害提高25%。

fields.english: Consecrates the ground beneath you for 8 sec, dealing Holy damage every sec to enemies on it. While standing on it you deal 15% more damage and heal for 0.5% of your maximum health every sec.
fields.translation: 将你脚下的地面奉献8秒，每秒对站在其上的敌人造成神圣伤害。你站在其上时造成的伤害提高15%，并每秒恢复0.5%最大生命值。

fields.english: Strikes the 3 strongest enemies within 30 yards for heavy Holy damage. Undead and Demons take triple damage, elites and bosses double. Critical strikes from your other Paladin spells reset its cooldown, at most once a sec.
fields.translation: 打击30码内最强的3个敌人，造成高额神圣伤害。亡灵和恶魔受到三倍伤害，精英和首领受到两倍伤害。你的其他圣骑士法术造成致命一击时，会重置此法术的冷却时间，每秒至多一次。

fields.english: Strikes the strongest enemy within 30 yards for heavy Holy damage and enemies within 5 yards of it for half. Undead and Demons take triple damage, elites and bosses double. Critical strikes from your other Paladin spells reset its cooldown, at most once every 0.5 sec.
fields.translation: 打击30码内最强的敌人，造成高额神圣伤害，并对其5码内的敌人造成一半伤害。亡灵和恶魔受到三倍伤害，精英和首领受到两倍伤害。你的其他圣骑士法术造成致命一击时，会重置此法术的冷却时间，每0.5秒至多一次。

fields.english: Holy light bursts around you, dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 12 yards and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 5%.
fields.translation: 圣光在你周围爆发，对12码内的所有敌人造成神圣伤害，并每命中一个敌人为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，最多5%。

fields.english: Holy light bursts around you, dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 10 yards and slowing normal enemies by 50%; Undead and Demons are stunned for 1 sec. Heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 3%.
fields.translation: 圣光在你周围爆发，对10码内的所有敌人造成神圣伤害，并使普通敌人减速50%；亡灵和恶魔昏迷1秒。每命中一个敌人为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，最多3%。

fields.english: Every strike from your other Paladin spells heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health, at most 6 times a sec. Falling below 30% health heals you to full, at most once every 90 sec.
fields.translation: 你的其他圣骑士法术的每次打击都会为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，每秒至多6次。生命值降至30%以下时，将你的生命值恢复全满，每90秒至多触发一次。

fields.english: Every strike from your other Paladin spells heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health, at most 6 times a sec. Critical strikes heal triple.
fields.translation: 你的其他圣骑士法术的每次打击都会为你恢复0.5%最大生命值，每秒至多6次。致命一击的治疗量提高至三倍。

fields.english: A golden bubble forms around you and blocks the next enemy hit that would take more than 5% of your maximum health. Falling below 30% health makes you immune to damage for 2 sec, at most once every 30 sec.
fields.translation: 一个金色气泡环绕你，抵挡敌人的下一次伤害超过5%最大生命值的攻击。生命值降至30%以下时，使你免疫伤害2秒，每30秒至多触发一次。

fields.english: A golden bubble forms around you and blocks the next enemy hit that would take more than 5% of your maximum health, then bursts, dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 10 yards.
fields.translation: 一个金色气泡环绕你，抵挡敌人的下一次伤害超过5%最大生命值的攻击，然后爆裂，对10码内的所有敌人造成神圣伤害。

fields.english: Burns every enemy within 12 yards of you with holy light, dealing Holy damage every sec. Enemies that strike you take double.
fields.translation: 以圣光灼烧你12码内的所有敌人，每秒造成神圣伤害。攻击你的敌人受到双倍伤害。

fields.english: Burns every enemy within 10 yards of you with holy light, dealing Holy damage every sec. Enemies that strike you take double. You take 10% less damage.
fields.translation: 以圣光灼烧你10码内的所有敌人，每秒造成神圣伤害。攻击你的敌人受到双倍伤害。你受到的伤害降低10%。

fields.english: Hurls a hammer at the strongest enemy within 20 yards, dealing Holy damage to it and every enemy within 6 yards and stunning the target for 2 sec. Bosses are not stunned.
fields.translation: 向20码内最强的敌人掷出一柄战锤，对其及其6码内的所有敌人造成神圣伤害，并使目标昏迷2秒。首领不会被昏迷。

fields.english: Hurls hammers at the 3 strongest enemies within 20 yards, dealing Holy damage and stunning them for 2 sec. Bosses are not stunned.
fields.translation: 向20码内最强的3个敌人掷出战锤，造成神圣伤害并使其昏迷2秒。首领不会被昏迷。

fields.english: Hammers of light fall on 5 random enemies within 25 yards, each dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 5 yards.
fields.translation: 圣光之锤砸落在25码内随机的5个敌人身上，每柄对其5码内的所有敌人造成神圣伤害。

fields.english: Hammers of light fall on 3 random enemies within 25 yards, each dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 5 yards. Every 3rd time, an extra hammer hits the largest group for triple damage within 10 yards.
fields.translation: 圣光之锤砸落在25码内随机的3个敌人身上，每柄对其5码内的所有敌人造成神圣伤害。每第3次会有一柄额外的战锤砸向最大的敌群，对其10码内的敌人造成三倍伤害。

fields.english: Hurls hammers at up to 3 enemies below 35% health within 30 yards. Normal enemies are slain; elites and bosses take heavy Holy damage.
fields.translation: 向30码内最多3个生命值低于35%的敌人掷出战锤。普通敌人被直接击杀；精英和首领受到高额神圣伤害。

fields.english: Hurls hammers at up to 3 enemies below 20% health within 30 yards. Normal enemies are slain; elites and bosses take heavy Holy damage. Each hammer also hits enemies within 5 yards for half.
fields.translation: 向30码内最多3个生命值低于20%的敌人掷出战锤。普通敌人被直接击杀；精英和首领受到高额神圣伤害。每柄战锤还会对其5码内的敌人造成一半伤害。

fields.english: Summons an Imp that hurls 2 Firebolts at a time at enemies within 30 yards, leaving them burning.
fields.translation: 召唤一个小鬼，每次向30码内的敌人掷出2枚火焰箭，使他们燃烧。

fields.english: Summons a Voidwalker that consumes enemies dying near it. After 8 it bursts in a void nova that hits every enemy around it.
fields.translation: 召唤一个虚空行者，吞噬其附近死亡的敌人。吞噬8个后，它会以虚空新星爆发，击中周围的所有敌人。

fields.english: Summons a Succubus whose Lash of Pain strikes all enemies in a wide arc in front of her and applies Shadow Vulnerability.
fields.translation: 召唤一个魅魔，她的痛苦之鞭会打击她前方宽广弧线范围内的所有敌人，并施加暗影易伤。

fields.english: Summons a Felhunter whose Shadow Bite deals 10% more damage per affliction on the target and interrupts spells, and whose Shadow Cleave hits every enemy in front of it. Every 10 sec it removes a harmful effect from you.
fields.translation: 召唤一只恶魔猎犬，其暗影撕咬的伤害随目标身上的每个诅咒效果提高10%，并可打断施法；其暗影顺劈斩会命中前方的所有敌人。每10秒，它会移除你身上的一个有害效果。

fields.english: Corrupts the 2 nearest enemies with 1 stack of Decay, or 2 on an enemy without Decay.
fields.translation: 腐蚀最近的2个敌人，施加1层腐朽，若敌人身上没有腐朽则施加2层。

fields.english: Curses the 2 enemies with the most health with 1 stack of Agony, or 2 on an uncursed enemy.
fields.translation: 诅咒生命值最高的2个敌人，施加1层痛苦，若敌人未被诅咒则施加2层。

fields.english: Drains the nearest enemy within 16 yards, dealing damage every sec and healing you for 0.2% of your maximum health per enemy drained.
fields.translation: 吸取16码内最近的敌人，每秒造成伤害，并每吸取一个敌人为你恢复0.2%最大生命值。

fields.english: Fires a Shadow Bolt at the nearest enemy, dealing damage. Nightfall: enemies that die with your afflictions on them fire a free bolt, at most 1 a sec.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人射出一发暗影箭，造成伤害。夜幕：身上带有你的诅咒效果死亡的敌人会触发一发免费暗影箭，每秒至多1发。

fields.english: Strikes the 2 nearest enemies with fire, dealing damage and applying 2 stacks of Burning.
fields.translation: 以火焰打击最近的2个敌人，造成伤害并施加2层燃烧。

fields.english: Fire burns every enemy within 8 yards of you, dealing damage.
fields.translation: 烈焰灼烧你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。

fields.english: Rains fire on the largest group of enemies for 4 sec, dealing damage and applying 1 stack of Burning every sec.
fields.translation: 向最大的敌群降下火焰之雨，持续4秒，造成伤害并每秒施加1层燃烧。

fields.english: Summons an Imp that hurls 2 Firebolts at a time at enemies within 30 yards, leaving them burning. Firebolts jump to 2 more enemies within 8 yards for 60% damage.
fields.translation: 召唤一个小鬼，每次向30码内的敌人掷出2枚火焰箭，使他们燃烧。火焰箭会弹向8码内的2个额外敌人，造成60%的伤害。

fields.english: Summons an Imp that hurls 2 Firebolts at a time at enemies within 30 yards, leaving them burning. Enemies its Firebolts kill call a lesser Imp for 6 sec, up to 6 at once.
fields.translation: 召唤一个小鬼，每次向30码内的敌人掷出2枚火焰箭，使他们燃烧。被其火焰箭击杀的敌人会召来一个次级小鬼，持续6秒，最多同时存在6个。

fields.english: Summons a Voidwalker that consumes enemies dying near it. After 8 it bursts in a void nova that hits every enemy around it and shields you for 5% of your maximum health.
fields.translation: 召唤一个虚空行者，吞噬其附近死亡的敌人。吞噬8个后，它会以虚空新星爆发，击中周围的所有敌人，并为你施加护盾，可吸收5%最大生命值的伤害。

fields.english: Summons a Voidwalker that consumes enemies dying near it. After 8 it bursts in a void nova that hits every enemy around it. Every 6 sec it slams the ground within 8 yards, knocking normal enemies away.
fields.translation: 召唤一个虚空行者，吞噬其附近死亡的敌人。吞噬8个后，它会以虚空新星爆发，击中周围的所有敌人。它会每隔6秒重击8码内的地面，击退普通敌人。

fields.english: Summons a Succubus whose Lash of Pain strikes every enemy around her and applies Shadow Vulnerability.
fields.translation: 召唤一个魅魔，她的痛苦之鞭会打击她周围的所有敌人，并施加暗影易伤。

fields.english: Summons a Succubus whose Lash of Pain strikes all enemies in a wide arc in front of her and applies Shadow Vulnerability. Every 8 sec she pulls the strongest normal enemy within 20 yards to her; it takes double damage for 2 sec.
fields.translation: 召唤一个魅魔，她的痛苦之鞭会打击她前方宽广弧线范围内的所有敌人，并施加暗影易伤。每8秒她会将20码内最强的普通敌人拉到身边；该敌人受到双倍伤害，持续2秒。

fields.english: Summons a Felhunter whose Shadow Bite deals 10% more damage per affliction on the target and interrupts every caster within 8 yards of it, and whose Shadow Cleave hits every enemy in front of it.
fields.translation: 召唤一只恶魔猎犬，其暗影撕咬的伤害随目标身上的每个诅咒效果提高10%，并会打断其8码内的所有施法者；其暗影顺劈斩会命中前方的所有敌人。

fields.english: Summons a Felhunter whose Shadow Bite deals 10% more damage per affliction on the target and turns off an elite's affixes for 6 sec, at most once every 10 sec, and whose Shadow Cleave hits every enemy in front of it.
fields.translation: 召唤一只恶魔猎犬，其暗影撕咬的伤害随目标身上的每个诅咒效果提高10%，并会使一个精英的词缀失效6秒，每10秒至多触发一次；其暗影顺劈斩会命中前方的所有敌人。

fields.english: Corrupts the 2 nearest enemies with 1 stack of Decay. Corrupted enemies explode on death, adding 1 stack of Decay to enemies within 6 yards. Explosion kills explode too, up to 2 in a row.
fields.translation: 腐蚀最近的2个敌人，施加1层腐朽。被腐蚀的敌人死亡时会爆炸，对其6码内的敌人施加1层腐朽。被爆炸击杀的敌人也会爆炸，最多连锁2次。

fields.english: Corrupts the 2 nearest enemies with 1 stack of Decay. Every 6 sec, each corrupted enemy within 30 yards takes the damage its Decay would deal over the next 3 sec, keeping its stacks.
fields.translation: 腐蚀最近的2个敌人，施加1层腐朽。每6秒，30码内每个被腐蚀的敌人会立即承受其腐朽在接下来3秒内将造成的伤害，并保留层数。

fields.english: Curses the 2 enemies with the most health with 1 stack of Agony. 10 sec after the first curse, Doom strikes for heavy Shadow damage; if it kills, a Doomguard fights for 15 sec.
fields.translation: 诅咒生命值最高的2个敌人，施加1层痛苦。首次施诅咒10秒后，厄运会降临，造成高额暗影伤害；若其击杀目标，一只末日守卫会为你战斗15秒。

fields.english: Curses the 2 enemies with the most health with 1 stack of Agony. When a cursed enemy dies, its Agony moves with every stack to the nearest uncursed enemy.
fields.translation: 诅咒生命值最高的2个敌人，施加1层痛苦。被诅咒的敌人死亡时，其痛苦会连同所有层数转移到最近的一个未被诅咒的敌人身上。

fields.english: Drains the nearest enemy within 16 yards, dealing damage every sec and healing you. Each enemy that dies while drained gives you a soul: 5% more damage for 10 sec, up to 10 souls.
fields.translation: 吸取16码内最近的敌人，每秒造成伤害并治疗你。每个在被吸取期间死亡的敌人会给予你一个灵魂：造成的伤害提高5%，持续10秒，最多10个灵魂。

fields.english: Drains the nearest enemy within 16 yards, dealing damage every sec and healing you. Healing past full health makes your demons deal 30% more damage for 4 sec.
fields.translation: 吸取16码内最近的敌人，每秒造成伤害并治疗你。溢出满生命值的治疗会使你的恶魔造成的伤害提高30%，持续4秒。

fields.english: Fires a Chaos Bolt at the nearest enemy, dealing damage. Every 4th bolt crits its target and every enemy within 8 yards for 150% damage. Nightfall: enemies that die with your afflictions on them fire a free bolt, at most 1 a sec.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人射出一发混沌箭，造成伤害。每第4发会对目标及其8码内的所有敌人造成致命一击，伤害为150%。夜幕：身上带有你的持续伤害效果而死亡的敌人会射出一发免费的箭，每秒最多1发。

fields.english: Fires a Shadow Bolt at the nearest enemy, dealing damage. Nightfall: enemies that die with your afflictions on them fire a free bolt, at most 1 a sec, that jumps to 2 nearby enemies for half damage.
fields.translation: 向最近的敌人射出一发暗影箭，造成伤害。夜幕：身上带有你的持续伤害效果而死亡的敌人会射出一发免费的箭，每秒最多1发，该箭会跳向附近的2个敌人，造成一半伤害。

fields.english: Strikes the 2 nearest enemies with fel fire, dealing damage and applying 2 stacks of Burning. The fire spreads to every enemy within 5 yards of each, for half damage and 1 stack of Burning.
fields.translation: 以邪能火焰打击最近的2个敌人，造成伤害并施加2层燃烧。火焰会蔓延至每个目标5码内的所有敌人，造成一半伤害并施加1层燃烧。

fields.english: Strikes the 2 nearest enemies with fel fire, dealing damage and applying 2 stacks of Burning and 1 stack of Decay.
fields.translation: 以邪能火焰打击最近的2个敌人，造成伤害并施加2层燃烧和1层腐朽。

fields.english: Fel fire burns every enemy within 8 yards of you, dealing damage. The ring widens as you lose health, up to 60% wider.
fields.translation: 邪能烈焰灼烧你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。火圈会随你的生命值降低而扩大，最多扩大60%。

fields.english: Fel fire burns every enemy within 8 yards of you, dealing damage. Your demons burn too, hitting enemies within 6 yards of them for half damage.
fields.translation: 邪能烈焰灼烧你8码内的所有敌人，造成伤害。你的恶魔也会燃烧，对其6码内的敌人造成一半伤害。

fields.english: Rains fel fire on the largest group of enemies for 4 sec, applying Burning. Each rain ends with an Infernal crashing down, dealing damage and stunning normal enemies within 6 yards for 1 sec; it then fights for 8 sec.
fields.translation: 向最大的敌群降下邪能烈焰之雨，持续4秒，施加燃烧。每次降雨结束时都会有一只地狱火砸落，造成伤害并使6码内的普通敌人昏迷1秒；随后它会为你战斗8秒。

fields.english: Rains fel fire on the 3 largest groups of enemies for 4 sec, dealing damage and applying 1 stack of Burning every sec.
fields.translation: 向最大的3个敌群降下邪能烈焰之雨，持续4秒，造成伤害并每秒施加1层燃烧。

fields.english: Calls down starlight on the strongest enemy for heavy Arcane damage. Empowered in Moonkin Form.
fields.translation: 召下星光打击最强的敌人，造成高额奥术伤害。枭兽形态下获得强化。

fields.english: Burns the 2 nearest enemies for Arcane damage and applies 1 stack of Moonfire. Empowered in Moonkin Form.
fields.translation: 灼烧最近的2个敌人，造成奥术伤害并施加1层月火术。枭兽形态下获得强化。

fields.english: A storm rages over the largest group of enemies for 4 sec, dealing Nature damage every sec and Dazing them. Empowered in Moonkin Form.
fields.translation: 风暴在最大的敌群上空肆虐4秒，每秒造成自然伤害并使其眩晕。枭兽形态下获得强化。

fields.english: Rakes the 3 nearest enemies for damage and 2 stacks of Bleed. Empowered in Cat Form.
fields.translation: 斜掠最近的3个敌人，造成伤害并施加2层流血。猎豹形态下获得强化。

fields.english: Shreds the most Bleeding enemy for damage, increased by 3% per stack of Bleed on it. Empowered in Cat Form.
fields.translation: 撕碎流血层数最多的敌人，造成伤害，目标每层流血使伤害提高3%。猎豹形态下获得强化。

fields.english: Swipes all nearby enemies for damage. Empowered in Bear Form.
fields.translation: 横扫附近的所有敌人，造成伤害。巨熊形态下获得强化。

fields.english: Every sec, heals you for 0.25% of your maximum health per nearby enemy, up to 5. Empowered in Bear Form.
fields.translation: 每秒根据附近的敌人数量为你恢复生命值，每个敌人恢复0.25%最大生命值，最多计算5个。巨熊形态下获得强化。

fields.english: Heals you for 0.3% of your maximum health. Its thorny bloom lashes the 3 nearest enemies for Nature damage. Empowered in Tree of Life.
fields.translation: 为你恢复0.3%最大生命值。其多刺的花朵会抽打最近的3个敌人，造成自然伤害。生命之树形态下获得强化。

fields.english: Summons 2 Treants. Their attacks apply Moonfire, and every 6 sec they root their target and nearby enemies for 2 sec. Empowered in Tree of Life, which calls 1 additional Treant.
fields.translation: 召唤2个树人。它们的攻击会施加月火术，并每6秒定身其目标及附近敌人2秒。生命之树形态下获得强化，并额外召唤1个树人。

fields.english: Roots grasp the 3 nearest enemies for Nature damage and root them for 2 sec. Empowered in Tree of Life.
fields.translation: 根须缠绕最近的3个敌人，造成自然伤害并使其定身2秒。生命之树形态下获得强化。

fields.english: Calms the air for 4 sec. Every sec, deals Nature damage to nearby enemies and heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health. Empowered in Tree of Life.
fields.translation: 使空气平静4秒。每秒对附近的敌人造成自然伤害，并为你恢复0.5%最大生命值。生命之树形态下获得强化。

fields.english: Enemies that strike you take Nature damage. Empowered in Bear Form.
fields.translation: 攻击你的敌人受到自然伤害。巨熊形态下获得强化。
